The library has no words of its own; it reads these from the page's island `#redz-ui-text`. A count takes the form the page language's plural rules name - `chip.full.one`, `chip.full.few` - and `chip.full.other` when the page gives no such form.

| Key | For | In English |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `remove` | A chip's remove button; `{label}` is the value's label | Remove {label} |
| `chip.added` | Said politely as values are taken; `{label}` is their labels | {label} added |
| `chip.removed` | Said politely as a chip is removed; `{label}` is its label | {label} removed |
| `chip.invalid` | What the entry's rules refuse; `{label}` is the typed words, or the entry's label when a number cannot be read | {label} is not valid |
| `chip.held` | A value held already; `{label}` is its label | {label} is already in the list |
| `chip.full.one`, `chip.full.other` | A value past `data-chips-max`; `{count}` is the most, in the page's digits | Up to {count} value, Up to {count} values |

## Tokens

From [`css/components/form.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/form.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-4`, `--redz-text`, `--redz-fs-12`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-link`, `--redz-motion`, `--redz-ease`, `--redz-danger-text`, `--redz-control-height`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-border-strong`, `--redz-radius-8`, `--redz-bg`, `--redz-focus`, `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-grow-rows`, `--redz-form-select-chevron`, `--redz-danger`, `--redz-warning`, `--redz-warning-text`, `--redz-radius-6`, `--redz-bg-page`, `--redz-primary-subtle`, `--redz-control-height-sm`, `--redz-control-height-lg`, `--redz-fs-16`, `--redz-control-height-float`, `--redz-fs-14`, `--redz-primary`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `col-form-label` | `form-label` | review | a form-label in a form-field |
| `form-control-plaintext` | - | review | readonly on a form-control, or plain text |
| `has-validation` | - | remove | fields have no success state |
| `invalid-tooltip` | `invalid-feedback` | review | the error under the field |
| `is-invalid` | - | state | aria-invalid="true" on the control |
| `is-valid` | - | remove | fields have no success state |
| `valid-feedback` | - | remove | fields have no success state |
| `valid-tooltip` | - | remove | fields have no success state |
| `was-validated` | - | state | the browser's :user-invalid shows after the person edits |

# Input groups

A field joined to what belongs to it - a unit, a prefix, a button, a choice - into one control. The borders meet by themselves; a menu or a hidden element inside the group is left out of the joining.

## Examples

`input-group` around a `form-control` or a `form-select` and its parts: `input-group-text` for words and icons, a `btn` for an action. An icon inside the field itself is [`form-adorn`](form.md).

```html
<div class="input-group">
	<input class="form-control" type="text" name="adult-price" inputmode="decimal" value="2,500" aria-label="Adult price" aria-describedby="input-group-basic-unit">
	<span class="input-group-text" id="input-group-basic-unit">THB</span>
</div>
<div class="input-group">
	<span class="input-group-text">https://</span>
	<input class="form-control" type="text" name="site-address" value="northbay.example" aria-label="Site address">
</div>
<div class="input-group">
	<input class="form-control" type="text" name="access-code" value="R7K2-9QXM" readonly aria-label="Access code">
	<button class="btn" type="button"><i class="bi bi-clipboard" aria-hidden="true"></i>Copy</button>
</div>
```

A plain `btn` wears the field's line and an accent face, so the group reads as one control; a plain `btn-icon` reads as `input-group-text`. A solid, outline, subtle or text button keeps its own look.

### With a choice

A `form-select` or a check joins the same way; a check goes inside an `input-group-text`.

```html
<div class="input-group">
	<select class="form-select" name="currency" aria-label="Currency">
		<option>THB</option>
		<option>USD</option>
		<option>EUR</option>
	</select>
	<input class="form-control" type="text" name="child-price" inputmode="decimal" value="1,900" aria-label="Child price">
</div>
<div class="input-group">
	<label class="input-group-text"><input class="check" type="checkbox" name="discount" checked>Discount</label>
	<input class="form-control" type="text" name="discount-percent" inputmode="decimal" value="10" aria-label="Discount, percent">
	<span class="input-group-text">%</span>
</div>
```

### With a floating label

A [`form-floating`](form.md#form-floating) grows in the group as a field does, and its parts take its height: an icon or a unit in `input-group-text`, a `btn` or a square `btn-icon`. A password keeps its `--reveal` button and its strength; the error goes under the group, in a `form-field`.

```html
<div class="input-group">
	<span class="input-group-text"><i class="bi bi-envelope" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>
	<div class="form-floating">
		<input class="form-control" id="input-group-floating-mail" type="email" placeholder="name@example.com" autocomplete="email">
		<label for="input-group-floating-mail">E-mail</label>
	</div>
</div>
<div class="form-field">
	<div class="input-group">
		<div class="form-floating">
			<input class="form-control" id="input-group-floating-password" type="password" placeholder="Password" autocomplete="new-password" aria-describedby="input-group-floating-level">
			<label for="input-group-floating-password">New password</label>
		</div>
		<button class="btn btn-icon" type="button" commandfor="input-group-floating-password" command="--reveal" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Show the password"><i class="bi bi-eye" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
	</div>
	<meter class="meter" min="0" max="4" low="2" high="3" optimum="4" value="0" data-strength="input-group-floating-password" aria-label="Password strength"></meter>
	<div class="form-text" id="input-group-floating-level" data-strength="input-group-floating-password"></div>
</div>
<div class="input-group">
	<div class="form-floating">
		<input class="form-control" id="input-group-floating-share" type="text" inputmode="numeric" value="20" aria-describedby="input-group-floating-unit">
		<label for="input-group-floating-share">Partner share</label>
	</div>
	<span class="input-group-text" id="input-group-floating-unit">%</span>
</div>
<div class="input-group">
	<div class="form-floating">
		<input class="form-control font-monospace" id="input-group-floating-secret" type="text" value="JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP" readonly>
		<label for="input-group-floating-secret">Secret key</label>
	</div>
	<button class="btn" type="button"><i class="bi bi-clipboard" aria-hidden="true"></i>Copy</button>
</div>
```

### With a menu

The menu sits in the group beside its button; the group joins only what it shows.

```html
<div class="input-group">
	<input class="form-control" type="search" name="q" placeholder="Search excursions" aria-label="Search excursions">
	<button class="btn" type="button" commandfor="input-group-menu-in" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu">Everywhere<i class="bi bi-chevron-down" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
	<div id="input-group-menu-in" class="menu" popover role="menu" aria-label="Search in">
		<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked="true">Everywhere</button>
		<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked="false">Titles</button>
		<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked="false">Descriptions</button>
	</div>
</div>
```

### Small, in a field

`input-group-sm` sizes every part of the group; `form-field` carries the label, the hint and the error outside it.

```html
<div class="form-field">
	<label class="form-label" for="input-group-field-months">Free months</label>
	<div class="input-group input-group-sm">
		<input class="form-control" id="input-group-field-months" type="text" inputmode="numeric" value="3" aria-describedby="input-group-field-hint">
		<span class="input-group-text">months</span>
		<button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon" type="button" aria-label="Remove"><i class="bi bi-trash" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
	</div>
	<div class="form-text" id="input-group-field-hint">Given with a yearly plan.</div>
</div>
```

## States

## Keyboard and accessibility

- Every field of a group has its own name - a `<label>` or `aria-label`. The words beside it are not its name: point at a unit with `aria-describedby`, so it reads as “Adult price, 2,500, THB”.
- The parts keep their own keys: `Tab` goes from the field to its button, a menu opens as every [menu](menu.md) does.
- An error goes under the group, in its `form-field`, never inside it.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/input-group.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/input-group.css). It declares `--redz-btn-bg`, `--redz-btn-fg`, `--redz-btn-hover`, `--redz-btn-hover-fg`, `--redz-group-bg`, `--redz-group-fg`, `--redz-group-hover`, `--redz-group-hover-fg` on its root, never on rows or items.

It reads the theme's `--redz-control-height-float`, `--redz-primary-subtle`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-text`, `--redz-border-strong`, `--redz-bg-page`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-bg-hover`, `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-radius-8`, `--redz-control-height-sm`, `--redz-radius-6`, `--redz-fs-12`.

# Checks, radios and switches

The browser's own checkbox and radio, drawn by the library: `check`, `radio` and `switch` on the input itself, `form-check` on the label around it.

## Examples

The class goes on the `<input>`; the label wraps it, so a click anywhere on the words toggles it.

```html
<fieldset class="vstack gap-8">
	<legend class="form-label">Included</legend>
	<label class="form-check"><input class="check" type="checkbox" name="transfer" checked>Transfer</label>
	<label class="form-check"><input class="check" type="checkbox" name="lunch" checked>Lunch</label>
	<label class="form-check"><input class="check" type="checkbox" name="kayaks">Kayaks</label>
</fieldset>
```

### Radios

Radios with one `name` are one choice; the arrow keys move it.

```html
<fieldset class="vstack gap-8">
	<legend class="form-label">Departure</legend>
	<label class="form-check"><input class="radio" type="radio" name="check-radios-time" checked>Morning, 8:30</label>
	<label class="form-check"><input class="radio" type="radio" name="check-radios-time">Noon, 12:00</label>
	<label class="form-check"><input class="radio" type="radio" name="check-radios-time">Sunset, 16:30</label>
</fieldset>
```

### Switches

A switch is a checkbox with `role="switch"`: on or off, applied at once. One that cannot change keeps its focus with `aria-disabled="true"` and says why in a hint.

```html
<label class="form-check"><input class="switch" type="checkbox" name="show-on-the-site" role="switch" checked>Show on the site</label>
<div class="vstack gap-4">
	<label class="form-check"><input class="switch" type="checkbox" name="hide-powered-by-redz-cms" role="switch" aria-disabled="true" aria-describedby="check-switches-why">Hide “Powered by REDZ CMS”</label>
	<div class="form-text" id="check-switches-why"><i class="bi bi-lock" aria-hidden="true"></i> Available with a partner license</div>
</div>
```

## States

A check with some of its items chosen is `indeterminate` - a property set from script, as there is no attribute for it.

## Keyboard and accessibility

- Space toggles a check or a switch; the arrow keys move the choice among radios of one `name`.
- A set of checks or radios sits in a `<fieldset>` whose `<legend>` names it.
- The marks are drawn from the browser's own `:checked` and `:indeterminate`, and keep showing in forced colors and in print.
- `aria-disabled="true"` keeps the control focusable and readable, so its hint can say why; the library ignores clicks and Space on it, as on a button so marked.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/check.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/check.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-border-strong`, `--redz-bg`, `--redz-primary-contrast`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-focus`, `--redz-border`, `--redz-bg-page`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-bg-hover`, `--redz-motion`, `--redz-ease`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `form-check-inline` | - | review | hstack gap-16 around the labels |
| `form-check-input` | - | review | check, radio or switch on the input, by its type |
| `form-check-label` | - | remove | the label is the form-check around the input |
| `form-check-reverse` | - | missing |  |
| `form-switch` | - | review | switch on the input, with role="switch" |

# Combobox

A choice from a list long enough to search: a button in the look of a select shows the value and opens a panel with a search field and the list. One core - the WAI-ARIA combobox with a listbox - also drives the command palette and a list in the page.

## Examples

The face is a button with `role="combobox"` that opens its panel by the browser's command; the panel is a popover with the search, the `listbox` and the value: one hidden field per chosen value, named by the list's `data-name`, so a form posts it as it is. Typing filters the list - case and accents aside, every word found, the best first - and the arrow keys move the active option while the focus stays in the search.

```html
<div class="form-floating">
	<button class="form-select combobox-toggle" type="button" id="combobox-one-face" role="combobox" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" commandfor="combobox-one-panel" command="toggle-popover"><span class="combobox-value" data-placeholder="Choose a language…">Thai</span></button>
	<label for="combobox-one-face">Default language</label>
</div>
<div class="menu combobox-menu" id="combobox-one-panel" popover role="dialog" aria-label="Default language">
	<div class="combobox-search">
		<i class="bi bi-search" aria-hidden="true"></i>
		<input class="form-control form-control-sm combobox-search-input" type="search" id="combobox-one-search" role="combobox" aria-controls="combobox-one-list" aria-expanded="true" aria-autocomplete="list" aria-label="Find a language" placeholder="Find a language" autocomplete="off" autofocus>
	</div>
	<div class="combobox-list" id="combobox-one-list" role="listbox" aria-label="Languages" data-name="language">
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-one-en" data-value="en" aria-selected="false">English</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-one-th" data-value="th" aria-selected="true">Thai</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-one-ru" data-value="ru" aria-selected="false">Russian</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-one-de" data-value="de" aria-selected="false">German</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-one-fr" data-value="fr" aria-selected="false">French</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-one-es" data-value="es" aria-selected="false">Spanish</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-one-zh" data-value="zh" aria-selected="false">Chinese</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-one-ja" data-value="ja" aria-selected="false">Japanese</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-one-ko" data-value="ko" aria-selected="false">Korean</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-one-ar" data-value="ar" aria-selected="false">Arabic</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-one-he" data-value="he" aria-selected="false">Hebrew</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-one-vi" data-value="vi" aria-selected="false">Vietnamese</div>
	</div>
	<p class="combobox-no-results" hidden>Nothing found</p>
	<input type="hidden" name="language" value="th" data-label="Thai">
</div>
```

### Many - a list on the button

A list with `aria-multiselectable="true"` keeps its panel open while options are chosen, and a field `name[]` holds each value. The button lists them in the page's language - "English, Thai, and Russian" - while they fit, else the first ones and the count of the rest.

```html
<div class="form-floating">
	<button class="form-select combobox-toggle" type="button" id="combobox-many-face" role="combobox" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" commandfor="combobox-many-panel" command="toggle-popover"><span class="combobox-value" data-placeholder="Choose languages…">English, Thai, and Russian</span></button>
	<label for="combobox-many-face">Site languages</label>
</div>
<div class="menu combobox-menu" id="combobox-many-panel" popover role="dialog" aria-label="Site languages">
	<div class="combobox-search">
		<i class="bi bi-search" aria-hidden="true"></i>
		<input class="form-control form-control-sm combobox-search-input" type="search" id="combobox-many-search" role="combobox" aria-controls="combobox-many-list" aria-expanded="true" aria-autocomplete="list" aria-label="Find a language" placeholder="Find a language" autocomplete="off" autofocus>
	</div>
	<div class="combobox-list" id="combobox-many-list" role="listbox" aria-label="Languages" aria-multiselectable="true" data-name="languages[]">
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-many-en" data-value="en" aria-selected="true">English</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-many-th" data-value="th" aria-selected="true">Thai</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-many-ru" data-value="ru" aria-selected="true">Russian</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-many-de" data-value="de" aria-selected="false">German</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-many-fr" data-value="fr" aria-selected="false">French</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-many-es" data-value="es" aria-selected="false">Spanish</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-many-zh" data-value="zh" aria-selected="false">Chinese</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-many-ja" data-value="ja" aria-selected="false">Japanese</div>
	</div>
	<p class="combobox-no-results" hidden>Nothing found</p>
	<input type="hidden" name="languages[]" value="en" data-label="English">
	<input type="hidden" name="languages[]" value="th" data-label="Thai">
	<input type="hidden" name="languages[]" value="ru" data-label="Russian">
</div>
```

### Many - chips

Where the chosen values are the field's content - categories, tags - the list names a container by `data-chips`: each value shows there as a chip with its remove button, and the button keeps its placeholder.

```html
<div class="vstack gap-8">
	<div class="form-floating">
		<button class="form-select combobox-toggle" type="button" id="combobox-chips-face" role="combobox" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" commandfor="combobox-chips-panel" command="toggle-popover"><span class="combobox-value" data-placeholder="Add a category…"></span></button>
		<label for="combobox-chips-face">Categories</label>
	</div>
	<div class="combobox-chips" id="combobox-chips-list-chips"></div>
</div>
<div class="menu combobox-menu" id="combobox-chips-panel" popover role="dialog" aria-label="Categories">
	<div class="combobox-search">
		<i class="bi bi-search" aria-hidden="true"></i>
		<input class="form-control form-control-sm combobox-search-input" type="search" id="combobox-chips-search" role="combobox" aria-controls="combobox-chips-list" aria-expanded="true" aria-autocomplete="list" aria-label="Find a category" placeholder="Find a category" autocomplete="off" autofocus>
	</div>
	<div class="combobox-list" id="combobox-chips-list" role="listbox" aria-label="Categories" aria-multiselectable="true" data-name="categories[]" data-chips="combobox-chips-list-chips">
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-chips-beaches" data-value="beaches" aria-selected="true">Beaches</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-chips-islands" data-value="islands" aria-selected="true">Islands</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-chips-diving" data-value="diving" aria-selected="false">Diving and snorkeling</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-chips-food" data-value="food" aria-selected="false">Food tours</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-chips-temples" data-value="temples" aria-selected="true">Temples</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-chips-markets" data-value="markets" aria-selected="false">Night markets</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-chips-parks" data-value="parks" aria-selected="false">National parks</div>
	</div>
	<p class="combobox-no-results" hidden>Nothing found</p>
	<input type="hidden" name="categories[]" value="beaches" data-label="Beaches">
	<input type="hidden" name="categories[]" value="islands" data-label="Islands">
	<input type="hidden" name="categories[]" value="temples" data-label="Temples">
</div>
```

### Tags that create values

A list with `data-create` ends with “Create …” while the search's words are no option's label and no chosen one - the page's text `create`. Taken, the new label is held in a hidden field `data-create` names, beside the list's own; the search empties for the next one. A page that makes the value on its server cancels `redz:create` on the list and answers with a promise of `{value, label}`: the list is busy until it settles, the new value is an option from then on - or, rejected, its words are said.

```html
<div class="vstack gap-8">
	<div class="form-floating">
		<button class="form-select combobox-toggle" type="button" id="combobox-tags-face" role="combobox" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" commandfor="combobox-tags-panel" command="toggle-popover"><span class="combobox-value" data-placeholder="Add a tag…"></span></button>
		<label for="combobox-tags-face">Tags</label>
	</div>
	<div class="combobox-chips" id="combobox-tags-chips"></div>
</div>
<div class="menu combobox-menu" id="combobox-tags-panel" popover role="dialog" aria-label="Tags">
	<div class="combobox-search">
		<i class="bi bi-search" aria-hidden="true"></i>
		<input class="form-control form-control-sm combobox-search-input" type="search" id="combobox-tags-search" role="combobox" aria-controls="combobox-tags-list" aria-expanded="true" aria-autocomplete="list" aria-label="Find or create a tag" placeholder="Find or create a tag" autocomplete="off" autofocus>
	</div>
	<div class="combobox-list" id="combobox-tags-list" role="listbox" aria-label="Tags" aria-multiselectable="true" data-name="tags[]" data-create="tags_new[]" data-chips="combobox-tags-chips">
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-tags-family" data-value="family" aria-selected="true">Family</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-tags-sunset" data-value="sunset" aria-selected="false">Sunset</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-tags-vegan" data-value="vegan" aria-selected="false">Vegetarian lunch</div>
	</div>
	<input type="hidden" name="tags[]" value="family" data-label="Family">
</div>
```

```js
document.addEventListener('redz:create', (event) => {
	if (event.target.id !== 'tags') {
		return; // the new label goes into the field data-create names
	}
	event.preventDefault();
	event.detail.respondWith(fetch('/tags', {method: 'POST', body: new URLSearchParams({label: event.detail.label})})
		.then((answer) => answer.ok ? answer.json() : Promise.reject('The tag could not be made')));
});
```

### Free values

A list with `data-create` and no options of its own takes free values - e-mail addresses, phone numbers, words - as chips: `Enter` or a comma takes the words, a value held already is not taken twice. A search with a `pattern` or `type="email"` refuses words it does not hold: the search is marked `aria-invalid` and the page's text `chip.invalid` says why.

```html
<div class="card">
	<div class="card-body vstack gap-8">
		<label class="form-label" for="combobox-free-search">Send the report to</label>
		<input class="form-control" id="combobox-free-search" type="email" role="combobox" aria-controls="combobox-free-list" aria-expanded="true" aria-autocomplete="list" placeholder="name@example.com" autocomplete="off">
		<div class="combobox-list" id="combobox-free-list" role="listbox" aria-label="Addresses" aria-multiselectable="true" data-name="to[]" data-create="to[]" data-chips="combobox-free-chips"></div>
		<div class="combobox-chips" id="combobox-free-chips"></div>
	</div>
</div>
```

### Options in levels

Options with `data-level` 2 or 3 are indented under the one before them, and a parent can be chosen as any option. The search keeps the page's order and shows a match with its parents, so a city is found with its country. The level is drawn, not said - an option has no `aria-level` in ARIA: an option whose name needs its parent carries it in its words or in its `menu-item-description`.

```html
<div class="card">
	<div class="card-body vstack gap-8">
		<input class="form-control" type="search" id="combobox-levels-search" role="combobox" aria-controls="combobox-levels-list" aria-expanded="true" aria-autocomplete="list" aria-label="Find a destination" placeholder="Find a destination" autocomplete="off">
		<div class="combobox-list" id="combobox-levels-list" role="listbox" aria-label="Destinations" data-name="destination">
			<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-levels-th" data-value="th" data-level="1" aria-selected="false">Northland</div>
			<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-levels-south" data-value="th-south" data-level="2" aria-selected="false">The south</div>
			<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-levels-main-island" data-value="main-island" data-level="3" aria-selected="true">Main Island</div>
			<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-levels-south-bay" data-value="south-bay" data-level="3" aria-selected="false">South Bay</div>
			<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-levels-north" data-value="th-north" data-level="2" aria-selected="false">The north</div>
			<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-levels-hill-town" data-value="hill-town" data-level="3" aria-selected="false">Hill Town</div>
			<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-levels-my" data-value="my" data-level="1" aria-selected="false">Southland</div>
			<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-levels-pearl-isle" data-value="pearl-isle" data-level="2" aria-selected="false">Pearl Isle</div>
		</div>
		<p class="combobox-no-results" hidden>Nothing found</p>
		<input type="hidden" name="destination" value="main-island" data-label="Main Island">
	</div>
</div>
```

### Groups, descriptions and icons

Options sit in groups - `role="group"` named by its `menu-header` - and carry an icon and a `menu-item-description`, which the search reads too; `data-keywords` adds words the option answers without showing them, and `aria-disabled="true"` keeps an option out of reach.

```html
<div class="form-floating">
	<button class="form-select combobox-toggle" type="button" id="combobox-groups-face" role="combobox" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" commandfor="combobox-groups-panel" command="toggle-popover"><span class="combobox-value" data-placeholder="Choose a role…">Editor</span></button>
	<label for="combobox-groups-face">Role</label>
</div>
<div class="menu combobox-menu" id="combobox-groups-panel" popover role="dialog" aria-label="Role">
	<div class="combobox-search">
		<i class="bi bi-search" aria-hidden="true"></i>
		<input class="form-control form-control-sm combobox-search-input" type="search" id="combobox-groups-search" role="combobox" aria-controls="combobox-groups-list" aria-expanded="true" aria-autocomplete="list" aria-label="Find a role" placeholder="Find a role" autocomplete="off" autofocus>
	</div>
	<div class="combobox-list" id="combobox-groups-list" role="listbox" aria-label="Roles" data-name="role">
		<div role="group" aria-labelledby="combobox-groups-content">
			<div class="menu-header" id="combobox-groups-content" role="presentation">Content</div>
			<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-groups-editor" data-value="editor" data-label="Editor" aria-selected="true"><i class="bi bi-pencil-square" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="menu-item-content"><span>Editor</span><span class="menu-item-description">Writes and publishes pages</span></span></div>
			<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-groups-translator" data-value="translator" data-label="Translator" data-keywords="languages" aria-selected="false"><i class="bi bi-translate" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="menu-item-content"><span>Translator</span><span class="menu-item-description">Translates what editors write</span></span></div>
		</div>
		<div role="group" aria-labelledby="combobox-groups-site">
			<div class="menu-header" id="combobox-groups-site" role="presentation">Site</div>
			<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-groups-manager" data-value="manager" data-label="Site manager" aria-selected="false"><i class="bi bi-globe2" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="menu-item-content"><span>Site manager</span><span class="menu-item-description">Runs one site and its settings</span></span></div>
			<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-groups-owner" data-value="owner" data-label="Owner" aria-selected="false" aria-disabled="true"><i class="bi bi-key" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="menu-item-content"><span>Owner</span><span class="menu-item-description">Only an owner gives this role</span></span></div>
		</div>
	</div>
	<p class="combobox-no-results" hidden>Nothing found</p>
	<input type="hidden" name="role" value="editor" data-label="Editor">
</div>
```

### Options from the server

A page that finds options itself listens for `redz:search` on the search and cancels it: the list is marked `aria-busy` until the page puts its options in - or sets `aria-busy="false"` when it cannot. This example answers from a short list after 400 ms.

```html
<div class="form-floating">
	<button class="form-select combobox-toggle" type="button" id="combobox-remote-face" role="combobox" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" commandfor="combobox-remote-panel" command="toggle-popover"><span class="combobox-value" data-placeholder="Find a person…"></span></button>
	<label for="combobox-remote-face">Assigned to</label>
</div>
<div class="menu combobox-menu" id="combobox-remote-panel" popover role="dialog" aria-label="Assigned to">
	<div class="combobox-search">
		<i class="bi bi-search" aria-hidden="true"></i>
		<input class="form-control form-control-sm combobox-search-input" type="search" id="combobox-remote-search" role="combobox" aria-controls="combobox-remote-list" aria-expanded="true" aria-autocomplete="list" aria-label="Find a person" placeholder="Find a person" autocomplete="off" autofocus>
	</div>
	<div class="combobox-list" id="combobox-remote-list" role="listbox" aria-label="People" data-name="assignee" data-docs-remote></div>
	<p class="combobox-no-results" hidden>Nobody found</p>
</div>
```

```js
document.addEventListener('redz:search', (event) => {
	const list = document.getElementById(event.target.getAttribute('aria-controls') ?? '');
	if (list?.id !== 'people' || event.detail.query.length < 2) {
		return; // the library filters the options it has
	}
	event.preventDefault();
	const {query, signal} = event.detail; // signal aborts when the query changes or the panel closes
	fetch('/people?q=' + encodeURIComponent(query), {signal})
		.then((answer) => answer.json())
		.then((people) => list.replaceChildren(...people.map(option)))
		.catch(() => signal.aborted || list.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'false'));
});
```

### A value set from the page

`REDZ.ui.combobox.set(list, values)` sets what a list holds as a choice does: its hidden fields, its button or chips, then `input` and `change`. `list` is the listbox or its selector, `values` one value or a list of them. A form's own `reset` goes back to the value the page came with; a Discard that goes back to the last saved value calls this.

### A list in the page

The same search and list without a button and a panel - a filter in a side column, a long choice in a settings page.

```html
<div class="card">
	<div class="card-body vstack gap-8">
		<input class="form-control" type="search" id="combobox-inline-search" role="combobox" aria-controls="combobox-inline-list" aria-expanded="true" aria-autocomplete="list" aria-label="Find a time zone" placeholder="Find a time zone" autocomplete="off">
		<div class="combobox-list" id="combobox-inline-list" role="listbox" aria-label="Time zones" data-name="zone">
			<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-inline-bkk" data-value="Asia/Bangkok" aria-selected="true">Bangkok · UTC+7</div>
			<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-inline-sgp" data-value="Asia/Singapore" aria-selected="false">Singapore · UTC+8</div>
			<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-inline-dxb" data-value="Asia/Dubai" aria-selected="false">Dubai · UTC+4</div>
			<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-inline-msk" data-value="Europe/Moscow" aria-selected="false">Moscow · UTC+3</div>
			<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-inline-ber" data-value="Europe/Berlin" aria-selected="false">Berlin · UTC+1</div>
			<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-inline-nyc" data-value="America/New_York" aria-selected="false">New York · UTC−5</div>
		</div>
		<p class="combobox-no-results" hidden>Nothing found</p>
		<input type="hidden" name="zone" value="Asia/Bangkok" data-label="Bangkok · UTC+7">
	</div>
</div>
```

## States

The button carries a field's states; an option is active where the arrow keys are - `data-active`, which the library sets - and chosen by `aria-selected="true"`.

## Keyboard and accessibility

| Key | On the button | In the search |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Enter`, `Space` | Opens the panel, the focus in its search | `Enter` takes the active option: one closes the panel, many stay |
| `↓` / `↑` | Opens the panel | The next / the previous option, round the ends; the first press goes to the chosen option |
| `Page Down` / `Page Up` | - | Ten options on / back |
| A letter | Opens the panel with the letter in the search | Types; the first match becomes active |
| `Esc` | - | Empties the search; on an empty search, closes the panel, the focus back on the button |
| `Tab` | - | Closes the panel and moves on |

- The button is the WAI-ARIA select-only combobox: named by its `<label for>`, its value its text, its popup a panel with `role="dialog"`; the library keeps its `aria-expanded`, and its `aria-controls` only while the panel is open - VoiceOver otherwise reads the value from the closed list, not from the button.
- The search is the editable combobox with list autocomplete: the focus stays in it, `aria-activedescendant` names the active option, `aria-selected` marks the chosen ones. The list follows the search in the page, so a screen reader on a phone reaches it by swiping.
- Once the typing pauses, the option `Enter` would take is said politely by its label - a screen reader busy with the typed keys says nothing of it - and with nothing found, the count, from the page's texts. The probes' engine `voiceover` holds these words against what VoiceOver says in Safari.
- A choice fires `input` and `change` on the list; a form's reset puts the values back as the page sent them.

## Texts

The library has no words of its own; it reads these from the page's island `#redz-ui-text`. A count takes the form the page language's plural rules name - `found.one`, `found.few`, `found.many` - and `found.other` when the page gives no such form.

| Key | For | In English |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `remove` | A chip's remove button; `{label}` is the value's label | Remove {label} |
| `create` | The option of a list with `data-create`; `{label}` is the search's words | Create “{label}” |
| `chip.invalid` | Words a search with a `pattern` or `type="email"` refuses; `{label}` is the words | {label} is not valid |
| `found.one`, `found.other` | The count of options found; `{count}` in the page's digits | {count} result, {count} results |

## Tokens

From [`css/components/combobox.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/combobox.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-focus`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-border`, `--redz-space-4`, `--redz-bg-hover`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-primary-subtle`, `--redz-primary`.

# Inline edit

A value changed where it shows - a title in a list, a name on a page - behind a real Edit button, in a small form of its own that saves or cancels.

## Examples

The value has an id; the Edit button names the form by `commandfor` with `command="--edit"`; the form, of class `inline-edit-form`, names the value by `data-for` and holds the field, its Save button and a Cancel button with `command="--cancel"`. `--edit` shows the form in place of the value, the field focused and its text selected; `Enter` saves, `Esc` or Cancel puts the field back, and the focus returns to the Edit button. A click elsewhere leaves the form open.

```html
<section class="card" aria-labelledby="inline-edit-row-title">
	<div class="card-header"><h2 class="fs-14" id="inline-edit-row-title">Excursions</h2></div>
	<div class="list-group list-group-flush">
		<div class="list-group-item hstack gap-8">
			<span class="table-title flex-fill" id="inline-edit-row-1">North Bay: marine park by speedboat</span>
			<button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text" type="button" commandfor="inline-edit-row-1-form" command="--edit" aria-label="Edit the title: North Bay"><i class="bi bi-pencil" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
			<form class="inline-edit-form flex-fill" id="inline-edit-row-1-form" data-for="inline-edit-row-1" hidden>
				<input class="form-control form-control-sm" name="title" value="North Bay: marine park by speedboat" aria-label="Title" required>
				<button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" type="submit">Save</button>
				<button class="btn btn-sm" type="button" commandfor="inline-edit-row-1-form" command="--cancel">Cancel</button>
				<div class="invalid-feedback" hidden></div>
			</form>
		</div>
		<div class="list-group-item hstack gap-8">
			<span class="table-title flex-fill" id="inline-edit-row-2">Night market and street food</span>
			<button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text" type="button" commandfor="inline-edit-row-2-form" command="--edit" aria-label="Edit the title: Night market"><i class="bi bi-pencil" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
			<form class="inline-edit-form flex-fill" id="inline-edit-row-2-form" data-for="inline-edit-row-2" data-docs-save hidden>
				<input class="form-control form-control-sm" name="title" value="Night market and street food" aria-label="Title">
				<button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" type="submit">Save</button>
				<button class="btn btn-sm" type="button" commandfor="inline-edit-row-2-form" command="--cancel">Cancel</button>
				<div class="invalid-feedback" hidden></div>
			</form>
		</div>
	</div>
</section>
```

### Saved by the page

The form's submit fires `redz:save` on it, with the form and the field's value. A page that saves cancels it and answers with a promise: the Save button is busy until it settles - resolved, the value shows the saved text and the form closes; rejected with words, the form stays open, the field marked invalid and the words in its `invalid-feedback`, said at once. Left alone, the value shows the text and the field keeps it. The second row above answers after 600 ms and refuses an empty title.

```js
document.addEventListener('redz:save', (event) => {
	event.preventDefault();
	event.detail.respondWith(fetch(event.detail.form.action, {method: 'POST', body: new FormData(event.detail.form)})
		.then((answer) => answer.ok ? answer.text() : answer.text().then((words) => Promise.reject(words))));
});
```

### Inside another form

A form cannot sit in a form: where the value lives in one - a settings page with a save bar - the edit form is a `popover="manual"` placed outside it, with the class `menu` for its panel; `--edit` opens it beside the Edit button.

```html
<div class="hstack gap-8">
	<span class="fs-16 fw-600" id="inline-edit-popover-name">Example Cruises</span>
	<button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text" type="button" commandfor="inline-edit-popover-form" command="--edit" aria-label="Edit the company's name"><i class="bi bi-pencil" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
</div>
<form class="menu inline-edit-form" id="inline-edit-popover-form" data-for="inline-edit-popover-name" popover="manual">
	<input class="form-control form-control-sm" name="company" value="Example Cruises" aria-label="The company's name" required>
	<button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" type="submit">Save</button>
	<button class="btn btn-sm" type="button" commandfor="inline-edit-popover-form" command="--cancel">Cancel</button>
	<div class="invalid-feedback" hidden></div>
</form>
```

## Keyboard and accessibility

| Key | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `Enter`, `Space` on Edit | Opens the form, the focus in the field, its text selected |
| `Enter` in the field | Saves |
| `Esc` | Puts the field back and closes the form, the focus on Edit |

- Edit is a real button named after what it edits - the value's own text may be a link to its record and stays one.
- The form saves only by its Save button or `Enter`: a blur never commits half an edit, and never throws one away.
- A refused save keeps the focus in the field; `invalid-feedback` takes `role="alert"`, so the page's words are said at once, and the field names it in `aria-describedby`.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/inline-edit.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/inline-edit.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-space-12`.

# File upload

Photos, documents, a price list: chosen, dropped or pasted, each file checked at once and sent on its own, with its own progress and its own error.

## Examples

`upload` holds the file input, an `upload-zone` button that opens it and takes files dropped on it, a `<template>` of one file's row and an `upload-list`. A paste while the focus is in the upload takes the clipboard's files. Each file is checked against the input's `accept` and the upload's `data-max-size` in bytes; a refusal shows in the file's row, the page's text `file.type` or `file.size`. A file dropped beside the zone does not open in the window.

```html
<div class="upload" data-max-size="2097152" data-docs-upload>
	<input class="visually-hidden" id="upload-photos-input" type="file" name="photos[]" accept="image/*,.pdf" multiple tabindex="-1" aria-label="Photos">
	<button class="upload-zone" type="button" aria-describedby="upload-photos-hint">
		<i class="bi bi-cloud-arrow-up fs-24" aria-hidden="true"></i>
		<span>Drop photos here, or choose them</span>
		<span class="fs-12" id="upload-photos-hint">JPEG, PNG or PDF, up to 2 MB each</span>
	</button>
	<ul class="upload-list" aria-label="Files"></ul>
	<template>
		<li>
			<i class="bi bi-file-earmark-image" aria-hidden="true"></i>
			<span class="flex-fill" data-file-name></span>
			<progress class="progress" max="1" value="0" aria-label="Sent"></progress>
			<span class="invalid-feedback" data-file-error></span>
			<button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text" type="button" data-file-remove><i class="bi bi-x-lg" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
		</li>
	</template>
</div>
```

### One file

An input without `multiple` holds one file: a new one chosen, dropped or pasted takes the place of the one before - its row, its sending, its place in the input - and of several dropped at once only the first is taken.

```html
<div class="upload" data-max-size="2097152">
	<input class="visually-hidden" id="upload-one-input" type="file" name="photo" accept="image/*" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Reference photo">
	<button class="upload-zone" type="button" aria-describedby="upload-one-hint">
		<i class="bi bi-image fs-24" aria-hidden="true"></i>
		<span>Drop a photo here, or choose one</span>
		<span class="fs-12" id="upload-one-hint">One image, up to 2 MB</span>
	</button>
	<ul class="upload-list" aria-label="File"></ul>
	<template>
		<li>
			<i class="bi bi-file-earmark-image" aria-hidden="true"></i>
			<span class="flex-fill" data-file-name></span>
			<span class="invalid-feedback" data-file-error></span>
			<button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text" type="button" data-file-remove><i class="bi bi-x-lg" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
		</li>
	</template>
</div>
```

### Thumbnails

`upload-thumbs` on the upload draws its files as 5rem squares: an `img data-file-preview` in the row's template shows the image itself, cut to fill, its remove button on the corner; a refused file keeps a whole row for its words. `data-max-files` takes that many and refuses the rest with the page's text `file.count`. A page that prepares each image first - resized, turned upright - answers `redz:files` with a promise of the new file, which takes the old one's place in the input.

```html
<div class="upload upload-thumbs" data-max-files="3" data-max-size="5242880">
	<input class="visually-hidden" id="upload-shots-input" type="file" name="shots[]" accept="image/*" multiple tabindex="-1" aria-label="Screenshots">
	<button class="upload-zone" type="button" aria-describedby="upload-shots-hint">
		<i class="bi bi-images fs-24" aria-hidden="true"></i>
		<span>Drop or paste screenshots here, or choose them</span>
		<span class="fs-12" id="upload-shots-hint">Up to 3 images</span>
	</button>
	<ul class="upload-list" aria-label="Screenshots"></ul>
	<template>
		<li>
			<img data-file-preview alt="">
			<span data-file-name></span>
			<span class="invalid-feedback" data-file-error></span>
			<button class="btn btn-xs btn-icon" type="button" data-file-remove><i class="bi bi-x-lg" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
		</li>
	</template>
</div>
```

```js
upload.addEventListener('redz:files', (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  event.detail.respondWith(createImageBitmap(event.detail.file, {imageOrientation: 'from-image'}).then(resize));
});
```

### Sent by the page

Each file fires `redz:files` on the upload with the file, its row, `progress(fraction)` for the row's bar and a `signal` its remove button aborts. A page that sends cancels it and answers with a promise: resolved, the row is done; resolved with the id the server gave the file - a string or a number - the row is a stored one from then on, as the server would write it, `data-file-stored` its id, and its Remove asks the page in `redz:remove`; rejected, the page's words show in the row's `data-file-error`. One file's error leaves the others. Left alone, the file joins the input's files and goes with the form. The example above answers in a second and a half.

```js
document.addEventListener('redz:files', (event) => {
	event.preventDefault();
	const {file, progress, signal} = event.detail;
	event.detail.respondWith(new Promise((sent, failed) => {
		const request = new XMLHttpRequest();
		request.open('POST', '/files');
		request.upload.onprogress = (step) => progress(step.loaded / step.total);
		request.onload = () => (request.status === 200 ? sent(request.responseText) : failed(request.responseText));
		request.onerror = () => failed('The file did not arrive');
		signal.addEventListener('abort', () => request.abort());
		request.send(file);
	}));
});
```

### Files the server holds

The server writes a row for each file it holds, as the template's, with `data-file-stored` - its id - and the name of its remove button. Remove asks the page in `redz:remove` with `detail.id` and `detail.row`: a page that cancels it and answers with a promise keeps the row busy until it settles - gone when it resolves, its words said in its `data-file-error` when it rejects. Left alone, the row goes, and a hidden field of its own with it, so the form sends the ids still kept. After each change the upload fires `redz:change` with `detail.count`, the files it holds, stored and new, `detail.pending`, those still sending, and `detail.failed`, those refused; `data-max-files` counts the stored ones too. While a file sends, the file field is invalid with the page's text `file.pending`, so its form waits. A file the page sends becomes such a row when its `redz:files` promise resolves with the id the server gave it. Below, the contract is in use by an invoice, and a paper added is sent and kept under the next id.

```html
<div class="upload" data-max-files="4">
	<input class="visually-hidden" id="upload-stored-input" type="file" name="papers[]" accept=".pdf,image/*" multiple tabindex="-1" aria-label="Papers">
	<ul class="upload-list" aria-label="Papers">
		<li data-file-stored="41"><input type="hidden" name="kept[]" value="41"><i class="bi bi-file-earmark-text" aria-hidden="true"></i><span data-file-name>contract.pdf</span><span class="invalid-feedback" data-file-error></span><button class="btn btn-xs btn-icon" type="button" data-file-remove aria-label="Remove contract.pdf"><i class="bi bi-x-lg" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></li>
		<li data-file-stored="42"><input type="hidden" name="kept[]" value="42"><i class="bi bi-file-earmark-image" aria-hidden="true"></i><span data-file-name>site-plan.png</span><span class="invalid-feedback" data-file-error></span><button class="btn btn-xs btn-icon" type="button" data-file-remove aria-label="Remove site-plan.png"><i class="bi bi-x-lg" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></li>
	</ul>
	<button class="upload-zone btn btn-sm" type="button"><i class="bi bi-plus-lg" aria-hidden="true"></i>Add papers</button>
	<template>
		<li>
			<i class="bi bi-file-earmark" aria-hidden="true"></i>
			<span data-file-name></span>
			<progress class="progress progress-xs"></progress>
			<span class="invalid-feedback" data-file-error></span>
			<button class="btn btn-xs btn-icon" type="button" data-file-remove><i class="bi bi-x-lg" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
		</li>
	</template>
</div>
```

### Pasted anywhere, cleared, settled

A file is pasted into an upload while the focus is in it. With `data-paste="page"` the upload takes files pasted anywhere on the page, or, with an element's id, anywhere in that element - a ticket's card. A paste into a text field that brings words stays words, though a word processor puts a picture of them beside: only a paste of files alone goes to the upload. Of several such uploads, the one in the open modal dialog takes the files, else the one that shows. `REDZ.ui.upload.clear(upload)` takes away the files not yet stored - their sending aborted - and keeps the stored ones, with one `redz:change` and the focus where it was; a reset of the form does the same. `REDZ.ui.upload.settled(upload)` answers a promise of `{count, pending, failed}` once nothing in it is sending: a Send waits on it.

```js
send.addEventListener('click', async () => {
	const {failed} = await REDZ.ui.upload.settled(upload);
	if (failed === 0) {
		form.requestSubmit();
	}
});
```

### An image field

`upload-image` on an upload of one image shows its image whole on white, `--redz-upload-image-height` tall - 12rem by default - with its remove button in the corner; the zone, a plain button here, replaces it. The `capture` of the input goes to the browser as it is.

```html
<div class="upload upload-image max-w-360">
	<input class="visually-hidden" id="upload-image-input" type="file" name="cover" accept="image/*" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Cover">
	<ul class="upload-list" aria-label="Cover">
		<li data-file-stored="7"><input type="hidden" name="cover_kept" value="7"><img data-file-preview src="img/lagoon.svg" alt=""><span data-file-name>lagoon.svg</span><span class="invalid-feedback" data-file-error></span><button class="btn btn-xs btn-icon" type="button" data-file-remove aria-label="Remove lagoon.svg"><i class="bi bi-x-lg" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></li>
	</ul>
	<button class="upload-zone btn btn-sm" type="button"><i class="bi bi-image" aria-hidden="true"></i>Choose another image</button>
	<template>
		<li>
			<img data-file-preview alt="">
			<span data-file-name></span>
			<progress class="progress progress-xs"></progress>
			<span class="invalid-feedback" data-file-error></span>
			<button class="btn btn-xs btn-icon" type="button" data-file-remove><i class="bi bi-x-lg" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
		</li>
	</template>
</div>
```

## Keyboard and accessibility

- The zone is one real button: `Enter` or `Space` opens the browser's picker; the input itself stays out of the Tab order, and its words - which follow the browser's language, not the page's - never show.
- A refused or failed file says why in its row, at once; a removed file's focus goes to the next file's remove button, else to the zone.
- Each remove button is named after its file, from the page's text `remove`.

## Texts

| Key | For | In English |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `file.type` | A file the input's `accept` does not take; `{name}` is its name | {name} is not a kind of file this takes |
| `file.size` | A file over `data-max-size`; `{size}` the limit in the page's units | {name} is larger than {size} |
| `remove` | A file's remove button | Remove {label} |

## Tokens

From [`css/components/upload.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/upload.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-space-4`, `--redz-space-24`, `--redz-space-16`, `--redz-border-strong`, `--redz-radius-12`, `--redz-bg`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-bg-hover`, `--redz-border`, `--redz-upload-image-height`, `--redz-radius-8`, `--redz-bg-page`, `--redz-space-2`.

# Choice tiles

A group of radios or checks drawn as tiles - a package, a plan, a way to pay - the chosen one the only thing in color.

## Examples

`label class="choice"` wraps the input and its content; the input covers the tile unseen, so a click anywhere on it chooses, the arrow keys move between radios as always, and the focus ring goes round the tile. A group is a `fieldset` with its `legend`, the tiles laid out by a grid.

```html
<fieldset class="vstack gap-8">
	<legend class="form-label">Top up by</legend>
	<div class="grid cols-2 md:cols-3 gap-12">
		<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="choice-amount" value="500"><span class="fs-20 fw-600 tabular-nums">500 THB</span><span class="fs-12 text-muted">About a month</span></label>
		<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="choice-amount" value="1500" checked><span class="fs-20 fw-600 tabular-nums">1,500 THB</span><span class="fs-12 text-muted">A quarter, 5% off</span></label>
		<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="choice-amount" value="6000"><span class="fs-20 fw-600 tabular-nums">6,000 THB</span><span class="fs-12 text-muted">A year, 15% off</span></label>
	</div>
</fieldset>
```

### With a logo

`choice-media` at the top of a tile is a white banner for a logo, white in both themes, so a logo on a transparent ground reads the same.

```html
<fieldset class="vstack gap-8">
	<legend class="form-label">Pay with</legend>
	<div class="grid cols-2 gap-12">
		<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="choice-method" value="promptpay" checked><span class="choice-media"><img src="img/qr.svg" alt="" width="40" height="40"></span>PromptPay<span class="fs-12 text-muted">Any bank app</span></label>
		<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="choice-method" value="card"><span class="choice-media"><i class="bi bi-credit-card fs-24" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>Card<span class="fs-12 text-muted">Any card</span></label>
	</div>
</fieldset>
```

### A choice that destroys

`choice-danger` draws a tile in the danger tone when chosen - the way out of a set of ways to keep. A colour beside the words: the tile's words say what it does.

```html
<fieldset class="vstack gap-8">
	<legend class="form-label">When you leave</legend>
	<div class="grid cols-2 gap-12">
		<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="choice-leave" value="pause" checked>Pause the account<span class="fs-12 text-muted">Back any time</span></label>
		<label class="choice choice-danger"><input type="radio" name="choice-leave" value="delete">Delete the account<span class="fs-12 text-muted">With every booking, for good</span></label>
	</div>
</fieldset>
```

## Keyboard and accessibility

- The input is the control and the tile's words its label: a screen reader says "1,500 THB A quarter, 5% off, radio button, checked, 2 of 3".
- The keys are the input's own: `Tab` into the group, the arrows between radios, `Space` on a check.
- The chosen tile is told by its border and tint, and by an outline in forced colors.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/choice.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/choice.css). It declares `--redz-choice-tone`, `--redz-choice-subtle` on its root, never on rows or items.

It reads the theme's `--redz-primary`, `--redz-primary-subtle`, `--redz-space-4`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-space-16`, `--redz-border-strong`, `--redz-radius-12`, `--redz-bg`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-danger`, `--redz-danger-subtle`, `--redz-color`, `--redz-focus`, `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-border`.

# Ratings

Stars that show a mark out of five - an average of reviews, a guide's score - and five radios drawn as stars for giving one.

## Examples

`rating` draws five stars filled to `data-v`, the mark's share of the most from 0 to 1 - 4.2 of 5 is `0.84`; the library sets it as `--v` through the CSSOM, so a page under a strict CSP writes no style. The stars are a picture: `role="img"` with the mark in `aria-label`, and the number in words beside them when it matters. They take the size of the text around them.

```html
<div class="hstack gap-8">
	<span class="rating" role="img" aria-label="4.2 of 5" data-v="0.84"></span>
	<span class="fw-600 tabular-nums">4.2</span>
	<span class="text-muted fs-12">128 reviews</span>
</div>
<div class="hstack gap-8 fs-24">
	<span class="rating" role="img" aria-label="3 of 5" data-v="0.6"></span>
</div>
```

### Giving a mark

`fieldset class="rating-input"` holds five radios, each an input before its `label`: the library hides the inputs and draws each label as a star, filled up to the one checked - and up to the one under the pointer. The words of each label are for a screen reader, in a `visually-hidden` span; the `legend` names the mark. The radios stay the control: the arrow keys move the mark, the form sends it.

```html
<fieldset class="rating-input">
	<legend class="visually-hidden">Your mark for the guide</legend>
	<input type="radio" name="rating-give" id="rating-give-1" value="1"><label for="rating-give-1"><span class="visually-hidden">1 star</span></label>
	<input type="radio" name="rating-give" id="rating-give-2" value="2"><label for="rating-give-2"><span class="visually-hidden">2 stars</span></label>
	<input type="radio" name="rating-give" id="rating-give-3" value="3"><label for="rating-give-3"><span class="visually-hidden">3 stars</span></label>
	<input type="radio" name="rating-give" id="rating-give-4" value="4" checked><label for="rating-give-4"><span class="visually-hidden">4 stars</span></label>
	<input type="radio" name="rating-give" id="rating-give-5" value="5"><label for="rating-give-5"><span class="visually-hidden">5 stars</span></label>
</fieldset>
```

## Keyboard and accessibility

- A shown mark is one picture with its words - "4.2 of 5" - not five stars read one by one.
- A mark given is a group of radios: `Tab` into it, the arrows move the mark, a screen reader says "4 stars, radio button, checked, 4 of 5".
- The stars are drawn in the warning tone on the strong border's grey; in forced colors, in the text colour on grey.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/rating.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/rating.css). It declares `--redz-rating-fill`, `--redz-warning`, `--redz-border-strong` on its root, never on rows or items.

It reads the theme's `--redz-star`, `--redz-radius-6`, `--redz-focus`.

# PIN pad

A short number that unlocks a trusted device: dots that fill as it is typed and a keypad for a finger, while the keyboard types as it always does.

## Example

`pin` around one field - `type="password"`, `inputmode="numeric"`, `autocomplete="off"` and the length in `maxlength`. The library draws the dots and the keypad: 1 to 9, 0 and delete. The PIN goes when its last digit lands: the pad asks the page in `redz:pin` with `detail.value`, and is busy while the page's promise runs. `false` clears the dots and marks them wrong - the page's alert says why; `true` leaves the pad as it is while the page goes on. Try 2580.

```html
<form class="vstack gap-16 align-items-center" method="post">
	<label class="form-label" for="pin-unlock-field">Enter your PIN</label>
	<div class="alert" id="pin-unlock-alert" role="alert"></div>
	<div class="pin">
		<input id="pin-unlock-field" name="pin" type="password" inputmode="numeric" maxlength="4" autocomplete="off" aria-describedby="pin-unlock-alert">
	</div>
</form>
```

```js
pad.addEventListener('redz:pin', (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  event.detail.respondWith(post({action: 'pin_unlock', pin: event.detail.value}).then((answer) => {
    if (answer.ok) {
      location.assign(answer.redirect);
    }
    return answer.ok;
  }));
});
```

### Any length

A `minlength` below the `maxlength` takes any length between them: the dots grow as it is typed, and the keypad gets an Enter key beside its 0. With no page listening the pad submits its form - on Enter, or at the last digit of a fixed length.

```html
<form class="vstack gap-16 align-items-center" method="post" action="#pin-any">
	<label class="form-label" for="pin-any-field">The site's enrolment PIN</label>
	<div class="pin">
		<input id="pin-any-field" name="pin" type="password" inputmode="numeric" minlength="4" maxlength="8" autocomplete="off">
	</div>
</form>
```

## Keyboard and accessibility

- The field is the control: it has the label, takes the digits from any keyboard and is read as a secure field with its length. The dots are drawn for the eyes only.
- The keypad is for touch: its keys stay out of the `Tab` order and never take the focus from the field. The delete and Enter keys are named by the page's texts `pin.delete` and `pin.enter`.
- `Enter` in the field sends a PIN of a length the field takes.
- Wrong, the dots turn red and shake once; with reduced motion they only turn red. The words of the page's alert are what says it.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/pin.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/pin.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-24`, `--redz-radius-8`, `--redz-focus`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-border-strong`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-danger`, `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-fs-24`.

# Repeaters

A list of the same few fields a person adds to and takes from: phone numbers, the lines of an invoice, the stops of a route. The page posts every row; the library adds and removes them.

## Examples

The list carries `data-repeat` and holds a `<template>` of one row. A button with `command="--add"` naming the list in `aria-controls` adds a row made from it - every `{i}` in the row's attributes, its names, ids and `for`, turned into a running index that never repeats - and puts the focus in its first field. A row's `command="--remove"` button takes the row away; the focus goes to the next row's first field, else the previous row's, else to Add. `data-min` and `data-max` hold the count: a button that would pass them is `aria-disabled`. Like `--toggle`, the buttons take no `commandfor`.

```html
<fieldset class="vstack gap-8">
	<legend class="form-label">Phone numbers</legend>
	<ul class="list-unstyled vstack gap-8" id="repeat-phones-list" data-repeat data-min="1" data-max="4">
		<li class="hstack gap-8">
			<label class="visually-hidden" for="repeat-phones-0">Phone</label>
			<input class="form-control" id="repeat-phones-0" name="phones[0]" type="tel" value="+1 202 555 0143" autocomplete="off">
			<button class="btn btn-icon btn-text" type="button" command="--remove" aria-label="Remove this phone"><i class="bi bi-trash" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
		</li>
		<template>
			<li class="hstack gap-8">
				<label class="visually-hidden" for="repeat-phones-{i}">Another phone</label>
				<input class="form-control" id="repeat-phones-{i}" name="phones[{i}]" type="tel" autocomplete="off">
				<button class="btn btn-icon btn-text" type="button" command="--remove" aria-label="Remove this phone"><i class="bi bi-trash" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
			</li>
		</template>
	</ul>
	<div><button class="btn btn-sm" type="button" command="--add" aria-controls="repeat-phones-list"><i class="bi bi-plus-lg" aria-hidden="true"></i>Add a phone</button></div>
</fieldset>
```

### The page's say

`redz:add` and `redz:remove` on the list come first, with the row in `detail.row` - the new one before it goes in, or the one about to go. A page that cancels one keeps the list as it is: it asks before a row with saved work goes, or fills the new row's fields first. Rows that carry a `data-value` also move with [`data-reorder`](list-group.md#list-group-reorder).

```js
document.getElementById('repeat-phones-list').addEventListener('redz:remove', (event) => {
	if (event.detail.row.querySelector('input').value !== '' && !window.confirm('Remove this phone?')) {
		event.preventDefault();
	}
});
```

## Keyboard and accessibility

- Add puts the focus in the new row's field and a removal puts it on the next row, so the person goes on typing without looking for it.
- Each row's field has its own label, hidden where the list's legend says enough; each remove button is named after what it takes away.
- A button that cannot act stays in the Tab order as `aria-disabled`, its clicks swallowed, so a screen reader still finds it and hears why.

# Editor

A text editor for REDZ.UI markup, a package of the release linked apart: words edited in place, the library's components changed through their own settings, live facts, an AI that only suggests, translations side by side, and a frame of its own where no script of the text ever runs. Nobody needs HTML; an expert may have it.

## Example

The page links `css/redz-ui-editor.min.css` and the module `js/redz-ui-editor.min.js` beside the library's own files, then calls `REDZ.ui.editor(host, options)`. The value is REDZ.UI markup in and out; `onChange` hears every change, and `getHTML()` gives the value at any time.

```html
<div class="btn-group" id="editor-demo-rights" role="group" aria-label="Whose rights the example shows">
	<button class="btn btn-sm" type="button" data-rights="expert" aria-pressed="true">Expert</button>
	<button class="btn btn-sm" type="button" data-rights="author" aria-pressed="false">Author</button>
	<button class="btn btn-sm" type="button" data-rights="translator" aria-pressed="false">Translator</button>
</div>
<div id="editor-demo-host"></div>
```

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="redz-ui/css/redz-ui-editor.min.css">
<script type="module" src="redz-ui/js/redz-ui-editor.min.js"></script>

const page = REDZ.ui.editor('#body', {
  value: stored,
  ids: true,
  rights: {design: true, structure: true, facts: true, review: true},
  placeholder: 'The page text',
  styles: ['/themes/site/content.css'],
  images: [{id: 'media', label: 'Media library', open: (api) => media.choose().then((file) => api.insert({src: file.url, alt: file.alt}))}],
  onChange: (html) => form.elements.body.value = html,
});
```

## Options and calls

| Option | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `value` | The markup to edit; it is cleaned before it is shown |
| `ids` | `true` keeps in the value every block's id, `data-block`, its protection, `data-lock`, who wrote it, `data-by` and `data-checked`, and what it was translated from, `data-from`: what a CMS stores, so a block keeps its history, its translations and its protection |
| `rights` | What this person may do, below; left out, all but HTML and protection |
| `placeholder` | The words of an empty text, also the text field's name |
| `lang`, `dir` | The text's language and direction, the page's by default |
| `styles`, `scripts` | The theme's stylesheets for the text and the previews, and its scripts for the previews, after REDZ.UI's own |
| `sites` | Other looks of the same text, `{id, label, styles}`, chosen in the strip above it |
| `languages`, `getLanguage(code)`, `onLanguage(code, html)` | The text's languages, `{code, label, dir, value, versions}`, chosen in the strip; the host keeps each one's value, and the session keeps what was written in it until then |
| `source` | The language translations are made from, the first of `languages` by default |
| `facts`, `onFact(key, text)` | The page's live facts, a list of `{key, label, text, editable}`, or a function of the language that answers one; `onFact` saves a new value and answers `false` to refuse it |
| `ai(task, {signal, progress})` | The host's way to its AI, below; left out, nothing of the AI shows |
| `onBatch({id, kind, by, blocks, taken, left})` | Called when a task's changes are decided, one call for one task: what a CMS records as one batch |
| `person` | `{name}`, who signs what is checked |
| `lens` | `false` takes the strip away |
| `blocks` | More blocks for the menu, `{id, label, group, icon, html}`, after the package's own |
| `images` | Sources of images, `{id, label, open(api)}`; a source calls `api.insert({src, alt, width, height, srcset, sizes, sources})` |
| `embed`, `grid` | Videos from YouTube and Vimeo, and the blocks of columns; both on unless `false` |
| `versions` | Each block's stored versions, `{id: [{at, by, html}]}`, shown in its History beside this session's |
| `onChange(html)` | Called after a pause in typing and after every command |
| `onReady()` | Called once the frame holds the text |

It answers `getHTML()`, `setHTML(html)`, `setRights(rights)`, `focus()` and `destroy()`.

## Prose and blocks

- Paragraphs, headings 2 to 4, lists, quotes, code and rules are prose: written in place, with the alignment and tone utilities.
- Every other element at the top of the text is a block, closed to the browser's editing. The words inside it are fields, found by walking it, so typing never breaks its markup, and every block carries a stable id.
- Hover a table for the bars of its row and column, a list for the bar of its item. Click a word for the element bar: its path, its settings and what can be done to it. The handle at a block's edge moves it, and opens its card when pressed.
- The card of a block holds its Settings, its Form, its History, and for those allowed its Protection and HTML. A setting is tried on while it is hovered or focused; nothing stays until it is chosen.
- A list of words can become bullets, numbers, a list group, cards, an accordion, steps or a table of two columns in the Form tab, without touching a word.
- A block's History takes that one block back and leaves the others as they are.
- A block that moves is drawn open: every accordion item open, every tab's panel under its tab's words. Its Preview runs it alive, in a dialog's frame of REDZ.UI's own CSS and JS.

What can be changed comes from the catalog, `tools/catalog.json`, also in the passport as `editor.catalog`. The build refuses a class the stylesheets do not have, and a variant of a covered component that is neither in the catalog nor set aside with a reason, so a new variant cannot be forgotten. Markup the catalog does not know, as a migrated body has it, comes back as it came: its words can be typed, it can be moved and deleted, and an expert can edit it.

## Rights and protection

| Right | What it opens |
| --- | --- |
| `html` | The source of the page and of a block: the expert mode |
| `ai` | What the AI can do; it acts with the person's own rights |
| `design` | Settings, forms, the style of a block, color and alignment |
| `structure` | Adding, moving and removing blocks, rows, columns and items |
| `facts` | Prices, dates and other live facts in the text |
| `lock` | Protecting a block and editing a protected one |
| `review` | Signing text an AI or a machine wrote as checked; without it a suggestion can be taken, and stays unchecked |
| `langs` | `'*'` or a list of the languages this person may write in |

The words of a block stay open to everyone allowed that language, so `rights: {}` is a translator or a proofreader. Given rights are all there is: a key left out is off.

Protection is `data-lock` on a block. `"form"` leaves the words open and closes the form, the place and the removal; `"all"` closes the words too. In the whole page's source a protected block shows as `<!--block ID-->` to those without the right, and comes back untouched.

**The rights only hide controls.** Whatever the browser sends can be forged, so the server compares every save with what the person may do, at every door that writes: the block's id says what changed.

## Typing and paste

- At the start of a line, `##`, `###`, `####`, `>`, `-`, `*` and `1.` with a space become a heading, a quote or a list; `**bold**`, `*italic*` and ``code`` become their marks.
- `/` on an empty line opens the blocks, narrowed by what follows it.
- A paste from Word, Google Docs or a spreadsheet, and Markdown from a chat, come in as REDZ.UI markup: a table stays a table, a heading a heading, every style and font stays behind. A link pasted over selected words links them. Inside a field a paste is plain words.
- Undo takes the caret back to where the change started. Nothing touches the text while a character is being composed: Thai and Burmese keyboards read the words around the caret.

## Live facts

A price, a date or a phone number is written once and stands in every place it is used: `<data value="KEY">its words</data>`. Type `@` in the text to put one in, or open Facts in the foot, which counts the places of each and changes it in all of them.

- The words carry the key, not the value, so a price that changes stales no translation, and an AI or a translator gets a token it cannot change.
- The checks find a value typed by hand where a fact holds it, and offer to make it a fact; a key the page does not know is marked.
- The server fills in each fact's words when it publishes; the words in the value are what the page shows until then.

## The AI

The editor never reaches a model: `options.ai` is the host's, async, and no key is ever in a page. It gets a task and answers it, as late as it likes; `signal` stops it and `progress(partial)` shows what came so far. It acts with the person's rights: a closed block is never sent.

| `task.kind` | The task also holds | It answers |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rewrite` | `how`: `shorter`, `simpler`, `warmer`, `fix`; `blocks` | `{blocks: [{id, fields}]}`, a text for each field |
| `tones` | `blocks`, one block | `{grid}`, three rows of three versions: rows from shorter to longer, columns from stricter to warmer, each version a list of fields |
| `translate` | `from`, `to`, `blocks` of the source's fields, `was` the translation that stands or `null` | `{blocks: [{id, fields}]}` |
| `write` | `words`, a person's request; `facts` | `{blocks}` of the passport's schema `editor.write` |
| `read` | `question`, `text`, the page as a visitor reads it | `{text}`, from that text alone; `progress({text})` as it grows |
| `alt` | `src`, an image's address | `{text}` |

Every task has an `id` and a `lang`. A block is `{id, hash, element, fields}`: its words as plain text, one string for each field, a fact as a token `⟦KEY⟧`. A rewrite answers plain words: marks on the words around a change stay where they are. `{refusal: 'why'}` says the model declined, shown as what it is, not as an error.

- **A suggestion never lands by itself.** Its changes are drawn word by word, by the language's own word breaks, each taken or left alone, and the value stays what it was until the last one is decided. One task is one step of undo.
- **An answer can only do so much.** One whose block changed in the meantime, whose fields do not fit or that lost a fact is left out, and the person is told.
- **The catalog holds what an AI writes.** `write` answers flat blocks, one shape a model is held to while it writes; the editor turns them into REDZ.UI markup by the catalog, so a kind, a tone or a size the library does not have cannot come out.
- **The tone pad** asks for nine versions in one request and opens at once. Each point is tried on the block; a version that lost a fact cannot be chosen.
- **Ask the page** shows what a visitor's assistant would answer from this page alone. What it cannot answer is a gap in the page.

### The host's side

- Call the model from the server. Give it the schema with the API's structured output for `write`; a union of every kind does not compile, and a pattern inside a schema stalls it.
- Read the model's stop reason before its JSON: only a finished answer is a result. A cut answer is broken JSON, and a refusal answers `{refusal}`.
- Page text is data, not instructions: say so, and tell the model to keep every `⟦KEY⟧` as it is, to change as few words as it can, and to leave out in silence what it cannot do.
- The rights hide controls: the server decides again what a person may ask.

## Side by side

In a language other than the source, **Side by side** in the strip shows the source beside the text, row by row, in a frame of its own. A translated block keeps the hash of the source's words it was made from in `data-from`, FNV-1a of the words as PHP's `hash('fnv1a32')` gives it, so only the block that changed goes stale.

- A stale row says what changed, when the source's `versions` hold the words it was made from, and offers to translate again or to say the translation is right.
- A block the language lacks offers a translation, or the block to write in by hand. Translate all sends every row left as one task.
- On a phone the two columns scroll sideways.

**Who wrote it** in the strip marks each block an AI or a machine wrote, or that was pasted, and who checked it. Text nobody checked is listed in the checks, which is what a site owes its readers where the law asks for it.

## The lens and the checks

- The strip above the text changes the width, the theme, the site and the language of the page under it, and it stays editable: the frame is a real page, so its media queries answer to its width and the site's own stylesheets draw it.
- The foot counts the words by the language's own word breaks, so Thai and Burmese count too, and lists what a reader, a screen reader or a search engine would stumble on, each with a way to it: an empty heading, a skipped level, an image without words, a vague link, a long paragraph, a table without a head, text nobody checked, a value typed by hand where a fact stands, translations left behind.

## Safety

- The text is edited in a frame whose own Content-Security-Policy runs no script: an `onerror`, a `<script>` or a `javascript:` link in a stored body or on the clipboard never runs, on load, on paste or later.
- Every value is parsed inert and cleaned before it is shown or given back: no script, style, link, meta, base, object or embed element, no `on*` attribute, no address that is not a path, a fragment, http(s), mailto or tel, no frame that is not https.
- The cleaner guards the editing page; the server cleans what it stores as well.
