
`spark-line` draws the runs as one line instead of bars - a size over the days, which climbs and falls, not runs that pass or fail -, its `data-v` the share of the scale the page chose.

```html
<p class="hstack gap-8"><span class="font-monospace">files-01</span><span class="spark spark-line" role="img" aria-label="Storage over 10 days: 41 to 48 GB"><i data-v="0.1"></i><i data-v="0.2"></i><i data-v="0.15"></i><i data-v="0.4"></i><i data-v="0.45"></i><i data-v="0.42"></i><i data-v="0.6"></i><i data-v="0.7"></i><i data-v="0.65"></i><i data-v="0.9"></i></span><span class="tabular-nums">48 GB</span></p>
```

### A strip of days

`spark spark-strip` fills its box with one cell a day, oldest first, each its state's colour by `data-tone` - `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `info` -, a day without one a grey track: not a short bar, which would read as a small value. In a `strip`, a box the strip measures, it shows 90 days, 60 below 560 px and 30 below 360 px, the oldest going first; the `strip-head`'s caption with the `data-days` of the days shown is the one that shows, so its words always match. A cell's `title` is its tooltip.

```html
<div class="strip" aria-label="Uptime of the site" role="group">
	<div class="strip-head"><span data-days="90">90 days ago</span><span data-days="60">60 days ago</span><span data-days="30">30 days ago</span><span>Today</span></div>
	<span class="spark spark-strip" role="img" aria-label="90 days: 84 up, 2 slow, 2 down, 2 without data" id="chart-strip-days"></span>
</div>
```

## A board of lanes

`table class="lanes"` lays a time window across: a header cell `lanes-scale` holds the captions, each at its `data-at`, and each row is a lane - its name in the `th`, which may hold a link or a button that shrinks to it and ends in an ellipsis - give it the whole name as its `title` -, and its track in the `td`. In a track `lanes-tick` marks a run at `data-at`, `lanes-tick-once` a single one, and `lanes-span` from `data-from` to `data-to` a run that goes on, hatched, with its caption. The red line is now, at the table's `data-now` - 0, the start, by default; the grid has `--redz-lanes-steps` parts, 8. A caption that would touch the one before it hides, in any language and at any width. Elements that share a [`data-highlight`](table.md#table-highlight) key light together: a lane, its track included, and its row in a table.

```html
<table class="lanes">
	<caption>The next 24 hours</caption>
	<thead><tr><td></td><th class="lanes-scale" scope="col"><span data-at="0">now</span><span data-at="0.125">18:00</span><span data-at="0.25">21:00</span><span data-at="0.375">00:00</span><span data-at="0.5">03:00</span><span data-at="0.625">06:00</span><span data-at="0.75">09:00</span><span data-at="0.875">12:00</span><span data-at="1">15:00</span></th></tr></thead>
	<tbody>
		<tr data-highlight="mail.queue"><th scope="row">mail.queue</th><td><span class="lanes-span" data-from="0" data-to="1" title="mail.queue - every minute">continuous</span></td></tr>
		<tr data-highlight="backup.nightly"><th scope="row">backup.nightly</th><td><i class="lanes-tick-once lanes-tick" data-at="0.458" title="backup.nightly - 02:00"></i></td></tr>
		<tr data-highlight="fx.rates"><th scope="row">fx.rates</th><td><i class="lanes-tick" data-at="0.04" title="fx.rates - 16:00"></i><i class="lanes-tick" data-at="0.207" title="fx.rates - 20:00"></i><i class="lanes-tick" data-at="0.373" title="fx.rates - 00:00"></i><i class="lanes-tick" data-at="0.54" title="fx.rates - 04:00"></i><i class="lanes-tick" data-at="0.707" title="fx.rates - 08:00"></i><i class="lanes-tick" data-at="0.873" title="fx.rates - 12:00"></i></td></tr>
		<tr data-highlight="invoices.send-reminders"><th scope="row"><button class="btn btn-text btn-xs" type="button" title="invoices.send-reminders">invoices.send-reminders</button></th><td><i class="lanes-tick" data-at="0.667" title="invoices.send-reminders - 07:00"></i></td></tr>
	</tbody>
</table>
<table class="table" aria-label="Agents">
	<thead><tr><th scope="col">Agent</th><th scope="col">Next run</th></tr></thead>
	<tbody>
		<tr data-highlight="mail.queue"><td class="font-monospace">mail.queue</td><td>Every minute</td></tr>
		<tr data-highlight="backup.nightly"><td class="font-monospace">backup.nightly</td><td>02:00</td></tr>
		<tr data-highlight="fx.rates"><td class="font-monospace">fx.rates</td><td>16:00</td></tr>
		<tr data-highlight="invoices.send-reminders"><td class="font-monospace">invoices.send-reminders</td><td>07:00</td></tr>
	</tbody>
</table>
```

## Accessibility

- A chart is its table: the caption names it, the header cells name the series, each row says its day and its numbers. `charts.js` gives a `chart` or `chart-rows` table the table's roles, since WebKit drops them once CSS lays the table out otherwise.
- A share bar and breakdown rows say their shares in words - the legend's, the rows' - and the bar repeats them.
- A color never speaks alone: the legend names every series, a state's segment is named by its header cell, and a sparkline's summary is its name.
- Three of the light theme's series colors are under 3:1 against the page: the legend and the table are what tell them apart.
- In forced colors every bar is drawn in the text color; the numbers are in the table.

# Calendars

A month of days with what happens on each, and a strip of days across the things that can be busy on them - equipment, rooms, boats.

## A package of the release

Calendars are linked apart, on the screens that show them, beside the two files; they need no script.

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="redz-ui/css/redz-ui-calendar.min.css">
```

## A month

`table class="calendar"`: a weekday header, the week starting on the day the page chooses, then six weeks of days. A day holds its `time class="calendar-day"`, its events - `calendar-event`, a [dot](dot.md) of a tone and the words, cut to the width, the whole in its `title` - and `calendar-more` for the rest. `data-outside` quiets a day of another month, `data-weekend` tints a weekend, `aria-current="date"` marks today. In a region narrower than 576 px the events fold to their dots. The heading, the previous and next months and the switch of views are the page's links.

```html
<div class="hstack flex-wrap gap-8">
	<div class="btn-group" role="group" aria-label="View">
		<a class="btn btn-sm" href="#calendar-strip">Days</a>
		<a class="btn btn-sm" href="#calendar-equipment" aria-current="page">Month</a>
	</div>
	<a class="btn btn-sm btn-icon" href="#calendar-equipment" aria-label="October"><i class="bi bi-chevron-left flip-rtl" aria-hidden="true"></i></a>
	<h3 class="fs-14">November 2026</h3>
	<a class="btn btn-sm btn-icon" href="#calendar-equipment" aria-label="December"><i class="bi bi-chevron-right flip-rtl" aria-hidden="true"></i></a>
	<a class="btn btn-sm btn-text" href="#calendar-equipment">Today</a>
</div>

	</tbody>
</table>
```

## Days in a state

A day's `data-state` tints it: `worked`, `open`, `pending`, `absent` and `off` - a time sheet, the days a person can still book. `calendar-legend`, a list of items with the same `data-state`, says what each tint means, and every day says its state in words too - in its button's name, or in a `visually-hidden` word when it is no button; in forced colors the states draw as a line, a dashed and a dotted one. `button.calendar-day` makes the day's number a button the page opens or picks the day with - its `aria-label` the whole date and the state, `aria-pressed` on the day picked.

```html
<table class="calendar">
	<caption>Alex Sample, November 2026</caption>
	<thead><tr><th scope="col"><abbr title="Monday">Mon</abbr></th><th scope="col"><abbr title="Tuesday">Tue</abbr></th><th scope="col"><abbr title="Wednesday">Wed</abbr></th><th scope="col"><abbr title="Thursday">Thu</abbr></th><th scope="col"><abbr title="Friday">Fri</abbr></th><th scope="col"><abbr title="Saturday">Sat</abbr></th><th scope="col"><abbr title="Sunday">Sun</abbr></th></tr></thead>
	<tbody>
		<tr><td data-state="worked"><button class="calendar-day" type="button" aria-label="November 2, worked" aria-pressed="false">2</button></td><td data-state="worked"><button class="calendar-day" type="button" aria-label="November 3, worked" aria-pressed="false">3</button></td><td data-state="pending" aria-current="date"><button class="calendar-day" type="button" aria-label="November 4, waiting for approval" aria-pressed="true">4</button></td><td data-state="absent"><button class="calendar-day" type="button" aria-label="November 5, absent" aria-pressed="false">5</button></td><td data-state="open"><button class="calendar-day" type="button" aria-label="November 6, open" aria-pressed="false">6</button></td><td data-state="off" data-weekend><button class="calendar-day" type="button" aria-label="November 7, day off" aria-pressed="false">7</button></td><td data-state="off" data-weekend><button class="calendar-day" type="button" aria-label="November 8, day off" aria-pressed="false">8</button></td></tr>
	</tbody>
</table>
<ul class="calendar-legend" aria-label="Day states">
	<li data-state="worked">Worked</li>
	<li data-state="pending">Waiting for approval</li>
	<li data-state="absent">Absent</li>
	<li data-state="open">Open</li>
	<li data-state="off">Day off</li>
</ul>
```

## Days across things

`table class="schedule"`: a column of names, kept in view while the days scroll by, then a column per day with its number and weekday. A cell holds how many are out; `data-state="busy"` tints it, `"over"` - more out than there are - marks it, and `data-weekend` tints a weekend's column. Put it in a scroller: `overflow-x-auto`.

```html
<div class="overflow-x-auto" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-labelledby="calendar-days-title">
	<table class="schedule">
		<caption class="visually-hidden" id="calendar-days-title">Equipment out, November 2 to 8</caption>
		<thead><tr><th scope="col">Equipment</th><th scope="col">2<abbr title="Monday">Mon</abbr></th><th scope="col">3<abbr title="Tuesday">Tue</abbr></th><th scope="col">4<abbr title="Wednesday">Wed</abbr></th><th scope="col">5<abbr title="Thursday">Thu</abbr></th><th scope="col">6<abbr title="Friday">Fri</abbr></th><th scope="col" data-weekend>7<abbr title="Saturday">Sat</abbr></th><th scope="col" data-weekend>8<abbr title="Sunday">Sun</abbr></th></tr></thead>
		<tbody>
			<tr><th scope="row">Excavator <span class="text-muted">(1)</span></th><td data-state="busy">1</td><td data-state="busy">1</td><td data-state="busy">1</td><td></td><td></td><td data-weekend></td><td data-weekend></td></tr>
			<tr><th scope="row">Scaffold set <span class="text-muted">(3)</span></th><td></td><td data-state="busy">2</td><td data-state="over">4</td><td data-state="busy">3</td><td></td><td data-weekend></td><td data-weekend></td></tr>
			<tr><th scope="row">Generator <span class="text-muted">(2)</span></th><td></td><td></td><td></td><td></td><td data-state="busy">1</td><td data-weekend data-state="busy">1</td><td data-weekend></td></tr>
		</tbody>
	</table>
</div>
```

## Accessibility

- Both are tables: a screen reader reads a day with its weekday's header, a cell with its thing and its day. Weekdays are `abbr` with the full name.
- A day's number is a `time` with its date; "+2" says "+2 more" with a hidden word.
- A busy or over cell says its number; the tint repeats it, and an over cell is also outlined in forced colors.
- A day's state is in words, never in its tint alone; a day that is a button is named by its whole date and its state, "November 4, waiting for approval", and the picked one says `aria-pressed="true"`.

# Media library

A folder of images as square tiles or as compact rows: checked for actions on many at once, moved by a handle, each with its own actions.

## A package of the release

The media library is linked apart, on the screens that show it, beside the two files; its switch of views and its reordering are the main script's.

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="redz-ui/css/redz-ui-media.min.css">
```

## A folder

`media-grid` lays `media-tile`s in as many columns as fit. A tile holds its `check` of class `media-tile-check`, a `drag-handle` when the folder keeps an order, the square `media-tile-thumb` - cut to fill, so tiles never jump -, `media-tile-body` with `media-tile-name` and `media-tile-meta`, and `media-tile-actions`. A checked tile is outlined; a tile the search hides is `hidden`. `data-view="list"` turns the tiles into rows without previews, the name with its file icon.

The switch is two buttons with `command="--view"`, `aria-controls` naming the grid and a `value`: the library puts the value in the grid's `data-view`, says in `aria-pressed` which view shows and tells the page in `redz:view` (`detail.view`); the library stores nothing - the page that remembers the choice writes `data-view` when it loads. With `data-reorder` the tiles move as a [list's items](list-group.md#list-group-reorder) do, in two dimensions in the grid. Checked tiles bring up a [selection bar](selection-bar.md).

```html
<div class="hstack flex-wrap gap-8">
	<h3 class="fs-14 me-auto">Bay tours · 4</h3>
	<div class="btn-group" role="group" aria-label="View">
		<button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon" type="button" command="--view" aria-controls="media-folder-grid" value="grid" aria-label="Tiles"><i class="bi bi-grid-3x3-gap" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
		<button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon" type="button" command="--view" aria-controls="media-folder-grid" value="list" aria-label="Rows"><i class="bi bi-list-ul" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
	</div>
</div>
<div class="media-grid" id="media-folder-grid" data-view="grid" data-reorder="media[]" role="list" aria-label="Images of the folder">
	<div class="media-tile" role="listitem" data-value="lagoon"><input class="check media-tile-check" type="checkbox" name="selected" value="lagoon.svg" aria-label="Select lagoon.svg" checked><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text drag-handle" type="button" commandfor="media-folder-moves" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="Move: lagoon.svg"><i class="bi bi-grip-vertical" aria-hidden="true"></i></button><img class="media-tile-thumb" src="img/lagoon.svg" alt="A lagoon under green hills" loading="lazy"><div class="media-tile-body"><span class="media-tile-name"><i class="bi bi-file-earmark-image" aria-hidden="true"></i><span>lagoon.svg</span></span><span class="media-tile-meta">1600×900 · 24 KB · 4 sizes</span></div><div class="media-tile-actions"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon" type="button" aria-label="Copy the tag: lagoon.svg"><i class="bi bi-clipboard" aria-hidden="true"></i></button><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon" type="button" aria-label="Where it is used: lagoon.svg"><i class="bi bi-search" aria-hidden="true"></i></button><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-subtle-danger" type="button" aria-label="Delete: lagoon.svg"><i class="bi bi-trash3" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></div></div>
	<div class="media-tile" role="listitem" data-value="qr"><input class="check media-tile-check" type="checkbox" name="selected" value="qr.svg" aria-label="Select qr.svg"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text drag-handle" type="button" commandfor="media-folder-moves" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="Move: qr.svg"><i class="bi bi-grip-vertical" aria-hidden="true"></i></button><img class="media-tile-thumb" src="img/qr.svg" alt="The QR code of the docs" loading="lazy"><div class="media-tile-body"><span class="media-tile-name"><i class="bi bi-file-earmark-image" aria-hidden="true"></i><span>qr.svg</span></span><span class="media-tile-meta">45×45 · 3 KB · 1 size</span></div><div class="media-tile-actions"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon" type="button" aria-label="Copy the tag: qr.svg"><i class="bi bi-clipboard" aria-hidden="true"></i></button><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon" type="button" aria-label="Where it is used: qr.svg"><i class="bi bi-search" aria-hidden="true"></i></button><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-subtle-danger" type="button" aria-label="Delete: qr.svg"><i class="bi bi-trash3" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></div></div>
	<div class="media-tile" role="listitem" data-value="pier"><input class="check media-tile-check" type="checkbox" name="selected" value="pier-at-dawn.svg" aria-label="Select pier-at-dawn.svg"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text drag-handle" type="button" commandfor="media-folder-moves" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="Move: pier-at-dawn.svg"><i class="bi bi-grip-vertical" aria-hidden="true"></i></button><img class="media-tile-thumb" src="img/lagoon.svg" alt="The pier at dawn" loading="lazy"><div class="media-tile-body"><span class="media-tile-name"><i class="bi bi-file-earmark-image" aria-hidden="true"></i><span>pier-at-dawn.svg</span></span><span class="media-tile-meta">2400×1600 · 31 KB · 5 sizes</span></div><div class="media-tile-actions"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon" type="button" aria-label="Copy the tag: pier-at-dawn.svg"><i class="bi bi-clipboard" aria-hidden="true"></i></button><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon" type="button" aria-label="Where it is used: pier-at-dawn.svg"><i class="bi bi-search" aria-hidden="true"></i></button><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-subtle-danger" type="button" aria-label="Delete: pier-at-dawn.svg"><i class="bi bi-trash3" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></div></div>
	<div class="media-tile" role="listitem" data-value="hidden" hidden><input class="check media-tile-check" type="checkbox" name="selected" value="boat.svg" aria-label="Select boat.svg"><img class="media-tile-thumb" src="img/lagoon.svg" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="media-tile-body"><span class="media-tile-name"><span>boat.svg</span></span></div></div>
</div>
<div class="menu" id="media-folder-moves" popover role="menu" aria-label="Move">
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem" data-move="up"><i class="bi bi-arrow-left flip-rtl" aria-hidden="true"></i>Move earlier</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem" data-move="down"><i class="bi bi-arrow-right flip-rtl" aria-hidden="true"></i>Move later</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem" data-move="first">Move to the start</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem" data-move="last">Move to the end</button>
</div>
```

```js
document.addEventListener('redz:view', (event) => localStorage.setItem('media-view', event.detail.view));
```

## Choosing

A chooser of images - the cover of a page, the photos of a tour - is a `fieldset` of tiles, each a `label class="media-tile"` around its `media-tile-check`: a `radio` to pick one, a `check` to pick some. A click anywhere on the tile picks it, and the focus ring goes round the whole tile; the body is made of `span`s, as a label holds no blocks. `media-grid-compact` takes smaller tiles and hides their words from sight - the radio is still named by them. `data-cover` marks a tile with a star and its own words, for the image a page shows first.

```html
<fieldset class="vstack gap-8">
	<legend class="form-label">The page's cover image</legend>
	<div class="media-grid media-grid-compact">
		<label class="media-tile"><input class="radio media-tile-check" type="radio" name="media-pick-cover" value="lagoon" checked><img class="media-tile-thumb" src="img/lagoon.svg" alt="A lagoon under green hills"><span class="media-tile-body"><span class="media-tile-name"><span>lagoon.svg</span></span></span></label>
		<label class="media-tile"><input class="radio media-tile-check" type="radio" name="media-pick-cover" value="qr"><img class="media-tile-thumb" src="img/qr.svg" alt="The QR code of the docs"><span class="media-tile-body"><span class="media-tile-name"><span>qr.svg</span></span></span></label>
		<label class="media-tile"><input class="radio media-tile-check" type="radio" name="media-pick-cover" value="pier"><img class="media-tile-thumb" src="img/lagoon.svg" alt="The pier at dawn"><span class="media-tile-body"><span class="media-tile-name"><span>pier-at-dawn.svg</span></span></span></label>
	</div>
</fieldset>
<fieldset class="vstack gap-8">
	<legend class="form-label">Photos of the tour</legend>
	<div class="media-grid">
		<label class="media-tile" data-cover="Cover"><input class="check media-tile-check" type="checkbox" name="media-pick-photos[]" value="lagoon" checked><img class="media-tile-thumb" src="img/lagoon.svg" alt=""><span class="media-tile-body"><span class="media-tile-name"><span>lagoon.svg</span></span><span class="media-tile-meta">1600×900 · 24 KB</span></span></label>
		<label class="media-tile"><input class="check media-tile-check" type="checkbox" name="media-pick-photos[]" value="pier" checked><img class="media-tile-thumb" src="img/lagoon.svg" alt=""><span class="media-tile-body"><span class="media-tile-name"><span>pier-at-dawn.svg</span></span><span class="media-tile-meta">2400×1600 · 31 KB</span></span></label>
		<label class="media-tile"><input class="check media-tile-check" type="checkbox" name="media-pick-photos[]" value="qr"><img class="media-tile-thumb" src="img/qr.svg" alt=""><span class="media-tile-body"><span class="media-tile-name"><span>qr.svg</span></span><span class="media-tile-meta">45×45 · 3 KB</span></span></label>
	</div>
</fieldset>
```

## Keyboard and accessibility

- Each check, handle and action is named by its image's file - "Select lagoon.svg", "Delete: lagoon.svg" - so a list of them still says which.
- The view buttons are a named group; the one that shows is pressed. A change of view keeps the focus on the button.
- A thumbnail's `alt` is the image's own; in rows it is not shown, and the name says the image.
- A chooser is a `fieldset` whose `legend` says what is chosen; each radio or checkbox is named by its tile's words - the image's `alt` and the file's name, the cover mark too. Arrow keys move among the radios of a chooser of one.

# Tables

A list of records: a title that links to the record, a line under it, a note when something is wrong, a column of checks for batch actions and the row's own actions at the end.

## Examples

`table` on the `<table>`; the row under the pointer lights on a device with one, in the color of `--redz-row-hover`, set on the page or on one table, and `table-static` keeps a table's rows still. The head stays at the top of the screen as the page scrolls, under the shell's header. A page with a sticky bar of its own sets `--redz-sticky-top` to the bar's height plus 12 px. Columns that only help on a wide screen hide below `md` of their card.

```html
<section class="card" aria-labelledby="table-list-title">
	<div class="card-header"><h2 id="table-list-title">Excursions</h2><span class="text-muted fs-12">3 of 28</span></div>
	<div class="card-body p-0">
		<table class="table">
			<thead>
				<tr>
					<th class="table-check"><input class="check" type="checkbox" id="table-list-all" aria-label="Select all"></th>
					<th>Excursion</th>
					<th class="text-end d-none md:d-table-cell">Price from</th>
					<th class="d-none md:d-table-cell">Status</th>
					<th class="table-actions"><span class="visually-hidden">Actions</span></th>
				</tr>
			</thead>
			<tbody>
				<tr>
					<td><input class="check" type="checkbox" name="selected" value="north-bay" aria-label="Select: North Bay"></td>
					<td><a class="table-title" href="#table-list">North Bay: marine park by speedboat</a><div class="table-sub d-none md:d-block">/excursions/north-bay/</div></td>
					<td class="text-end tabular-nums text-nowrap d-none md:d-table-cell">2,500 THB</td>
					<td class="d-none md:d-table-cell"><span class="badge"><i class="bi bi-check2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Published</span></td>
					<td class="table-actions"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text" type="button" aria-label="Edit: North Bay"><i class="bi bi-pencil" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></td>
				</tr>
				<tr class="table-danger">
					<td><input class="check" type="checkbox" name="selected" value="elephant-sanctuary" aria-label="Select: Elephant sanctuary"></td>
					<td><a class="table-title" href="#table-list">Elephant sanctuary: feeding and a walk</a><div class="table-note"><i class="bi bi-x-octagon-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="text-muted">Did not rebuild: a PHP warning in the theme template</span></div></td>
					<td class="text-end tabular-nums text-nowrap d-none md:d-table-cell">2,600 THB</td>
					<td class="d-none md:d-table-cell"><span class="badge badge-subtle-danger"><i class="bi bi-x-octagon" aria-hidden="true"></i>Failed</span></td>
					<td class="table-actions"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text" type="button" aria-label="Rebuild: Elephant sanctuary"><i class="bi bi-arrow-repeat" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></td>
				</tr>
				<tr class="table-warning">
					<td><input class="check" type="checkbox" name="selected" value="night-market" aria-label="Select: Night market"></td>
					<td><a class="table-title" href="#table-list">Night market and street food</a><div class="table-note"><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="text-muted">The Thai translation is older than the English</span></div></td>
					<td class="text-end tabular-nums text-nowrap d-none md:d-table-cell">900 THB</td>
					<td class="d-none md:d-table-cell"><span class="badge badge-subtle-warning"><i class="bi bi-clock-history" aria-hidden="true"></i>Stale</span></td>
					<td class="table-actions"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text" type="button" aria-label="Edit: Night market"><i class="bi bi-pencil" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></td>
				</tr>
				<tr class="table-secondary">
					<td><input class="check" type="checkbox" name="selected" value="folk-dance" aria-label="Select: Folk dance"></td>
					<td><a class="table-title" href="#table-list">Folk dance: an evening at the stadium</a><div class="table-sub d-none md:d-block">withdrawn from the sites</div></td>
					<td class="text-end tabular-nums text-nowrap d-none md:d-table-cell">1,500 THB</td>
					<td class="d-none md:d-table-cell"><span class="badge"><i class="bi bi-eye-slash" aria-hidden="true"></i>Withdrawn</span></td>
					<td class="table-actions"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text" type="button" aria-label="Edit: Folk dance"><i class="bi bi-pencil" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></td>
				</tr>
			</tbody>
		</table>
	</div>
</section>
```

### Checked rows

A checked row is tinted: its check is the only state. An element with `data-select` - the table, or the card holding it with its [selection bar](selection-bar.md) - holds a selection; a check with `data-select-all` heads its checks, checked when all are, mixed when some are, and pressed it checks or clears them all. Only the checks a person can use count: enabled, and not in a row a filter or the page hides - a checked row hidden leaves the count while hidden and is checked again when it shows. The `selection-bar` inside hides at zero, a `data-select-count` says the page's text `selected`, and the scope fires `redz:selection` with `{count, total, values}`, the values of the checked checks; a head that changes them all says the count aloud. With `data-select="rows"` a click anywhere on a row but on its controls checks it, unless its text is being selected. A `data-select` inside another is a group with a head of its own; buttons with `command="--select-all"` or `"--select-none"` and `aria-controls` naming a scope do what its head does. Scopes the page puts in or marks later are read the same, and so are a check's `disabled`, `checked` or `hidden` and a row's `hidden` set by code. A check's `checked` property set by code fires nothing a script can see: the page fires `change` on the check, or calls `REDZ.ui.selection(scope)`, which reads the scope again and fires `redz:selection` if the selection changed.

```html
<input class="form-control" type="search" name="q" data-filter="table-select-rows" aria-label="Find a guest" placeholder="Find a guest" autocomplete="off">
<section class="card" aria-labelledby="table-select-title" data-select="rows">
	<div class="card-header"><h2 class="fs-14" id="table-select-title">Guests</h2></div>
	<div class="selection-bar" role="region" aria-label="Selected guests" hidden>
		<strong data-select-count></strong>
		<button class="btn btn-sm" type="button"><i class="bi bi-envelope" aria-hidden="true"></i>Write to them</button>
		<button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text ms-auto" type="button" command="--select-none" aria-controls="table-select-rows" aria-label="Clear the selection"><i class="bi bi-x" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
	</div>
	<table class="table" id="table-select-rows">
		<thead><tr><th class="table-check"><input class="check" type="checkbox" id="table-select-all" data-select-all aria-label="Select all"></th><th scope="col">Guest</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Seats</th></tr></thead>
		<tbody>
			<tr><td class="table-check"><input class="check" type="checkbox" name="selected" value="11" aria-label="Select: Alex Sample"></td><td>Alex Sample</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">2</td></tr>
			<tr><td class="table-check"><input class="check" type="checkbox" name="selected" value="12" aria-label="Select: Ben Sample"></td><td>Ben Sample</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">3</td></tr>
			<tr><td class="table-check"><input class="check" type="checkbox" name="selected" value="13" aria-label="Select: Chris Sample"></td><td>Chris Sample</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">4</td></tr>
			<tr><td class="table-check"><input class="check" type="checkbox" name="selected" value="14" aria-label="Select: Dana Sample" disabled></td><td>Dana Sample<div class="table-sub">already written to</div></td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">1</td></tr>
		</tbody>
	</table>
</section>
```

### Stripes, borders and groups

`table-striped` shades every other row, `table-striped-columns` every other column - under the hover's light and a row's tone alike; `table-group-divider` on a `tbody` draws a stronger line above it. `table-bordered` draws the lines between columns and, outside a card, the table's own frame; `table-borderless` takes the lines between rows away.

```html
<section class="card" aria-labelledby="table-variants-title">
	<div class="card-header"><h2 class="fs-14" id="table-variants-title">Boats this week</h2></div>
	<table class="table table-striped">
		<thead><tr><th scope="col">Boat</th><th class="text-end" scope="col">Trips</th><th class="text-end" scope="col">Seats sold</th></tr></thead>
		<tbody>
			<tr><td>Boat A</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">12</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">286</td></tr>
			<tr><td>Boat C</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">9</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">201</td></tr>
			<tr><td>Boat B</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">7</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">164</td></tr>
		</tbody>
		<tbody class="table-group-divider">
			<tr><td>All boats</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">28</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">651</td></tr>
		</tbody>
	</table>
</section>
<table class="table table-bordered" aria-label="Seasons on Main Island">
	<thead><tr><th scope="col">Season</th><th scope="col">Months</th><th scope="col">The sea</th></tr></thead>
	<tbody>
		<tr><td>Dry</td><td>January to April</td><td>Calm</td></tr>
		<tr><td>Hot</td><td>May to August</td><td>Calm</td></tr>
		<tr><td>Rainy</td><td>September to December</td><td>Waves</td></tr>
	</tbody>
</table>
```

### Row sizes

`data-density="compact"` tightens the rows and the controls of the element it is on and of everything inside it: a table, the card that holds it, a region, or the whole page on `<html>`. A compact table can stand beside a normal one on the same screen. Bootstrap 5 calls it `table-sm`. `data-density="comfortable"` and `data-density="spacious"` open the rows up the other way, for a short table that is the point of a page.

```html
<table class="table table-bordered" data-density="compact" aria-label="Seasons on Main Island, compact">
	<thead><tr><th scope="col">Season</th><th scope="col">Months</th><th scope="col">The sea</th></tr></thead>
	<tbody>
		<tr><td>Dry</td><td>January to April</td><td>Calm</td></tr>
		<tr><td>Hot</td><td>May to August</td><td>Calm</td></tr>
		<tr><td>Rainy</td><td>September to December</td><td>Waves</td></tr>
	</tbody>
</table>
<table class="table table-bordered" data-density="spacious" aria-label="Seasons on Main Island, spacious">
	<thead><tr><th scope="col">Season</th><th scope="col">Months</th><th scope="col">The sea</th></tr></thead>
	<tbody>
		<tr><td>Dry</td><td>January to April</td><td>Calm</td></tr>
		<tr><td>Hot</td><td>May to August</td><td>Calm</td></tr>
	</tbody>
</table>
```

### Rows that stay still

Every table lights the row under the pointer. `table-static` keeps the rows of one still, for a table with nothing to do in a row.

```html
<table class="table" aria-label="Departures">
	<tbody>
		<tr><td>North Bay</td><td>08:00</td></tr>
		<tr><td>Turtle Cove</td><td>10:30</td></tr>
	</tbody>
</table>
<table class="table table-static" aria-label="Fares">
	<tbody>
		<tr><td>Adult</td><td>1,200</td></tr>
		<tr><td>Child</td><td>600</td></tr>
	</tbody>
</table>
```

### A menu in a row

A row's menu stands in `table-actions` right after its button. While it is open the row keeps its light and its actions, wherever the pointer goes, and the menu takes nothing from the cell. Rows may also share one menu kept outside the table: each button names it, and the row of the button that opened it stays lit.

```html
<table class="table" aria-label="Departures">
	<thead>
		<tr><th scope="col">Excursion</th><th scope="col">Leaves</th><th class="table-actions"><span class="visually-hidden">Actions</span></th></tr>
	</thead>
	<tbody>
		<tr>
			<td>North Bay</td>
			<td>08:00</td>
			<td class="table-actions">
				<button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text" type="button" aria-label="Edit: North Bay"><i class="bi bi-pencil" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
				<button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text" type="button" commandfor="table-row-menu-bay" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="More: North Bay"><i class="bi bi-three-dots" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
				<div id="table-row-menu-bay" class="menu" popover role="menu" aria-label="More: North Bay">
					<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem"><i class="bi bi-files" aria-hidden="true"></i>Duplicate</button>
					<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem"><i class="bi bi-eye-slash" aria-hidden="true"></i>Withdraw</button>
				</div>
			</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td>Turtle Cove</td>
			<td>10:30</td>
			<td class="table-actions">
				<button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text" type="button" aria-label="Edit: Turtle Cove"><i class="bi bi-pencil" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
				<button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text" type="button" commandfor="table-row-menu-cove" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="More: Turtle Cove"><i class="bi bi-three-dots" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
				<div id="table-row-menu-cove" class="menu" popover role="menu" aria-label="More: Turtle Cove">
					<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem"><i class="bi bi-files" aria-hidden="true"></i>Duplicate</button>
					<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem"><i class="bi bi-eye-slash" aria-hidden="true"></i>Withdraw</button>
				</div>
			</td>
		</tr>
	</tbody>
</table>
```

### Rows that light together

Elements that share a `data-highlight` key light together: hovering or focusing one marks every element with its key `data-highlighted`, tinted - a row here and its lane on a [board](chart.md#chart-lanes), or its marker on a map. A mark the page sets itself, `data-highlighted="hold"`, stays until the page takes it away: a row flashed after a jump to it, say.

```html
<div class="hstack flex-wrap gap-8">
	<button class="btn btn-sm" type="button" data-highlight="pier">The pier</button>
	<button class="btn btn-sm" type="button" data-highlight="lake">The emerald lake</button>
</div>
<table class="table" aria-label="Stops">
	<tbody>
		<tr data-highlight="pier"><td>The pier</td><td class="tabular-nums">08:30</td></tr>
		<tr data-highlight="lake"><td>The emerald lake</td><td class="tabular-nums">11:00</td></tr>
	</tbody>
</table>
```

### Sortable columns

A header that sorts holds a `button class="table-sort"`, and the header's `aria-sort` - `ascending`, `descending` or none - draws the arrow. With a `value`, the button sorts the rows in place: by each row's `data-sort-VALUE`, else its cell's `data-sort-value`, else the cell's text - numbers as numbers, words in the page's language with their digits as numbers, an empty value last both ways, equal ones in the order the rows were drawn. A band's rows stay under it, its subtotal last. The first press sorts ascending, or as the button's `data-sort-first="descending"` says - newest, largest first; the next turns it, and on a table with `data-sort-reset` a third press brings back the order the rows were drawn in. The page's texts `sort.ascending`, `sort.descending` and `sort.none` say it aloud. Rows the page puts in are sorted the same, and `REDZ.ui.sort(table)` sorts again. Without a `value` the button only draws: the page sorts and moves `aria-sort`.

```html
<table class="table" aria-label="Owners">
	<thead><tr><th scope="col" aria-sort="ascending"><button class="table-sort" type="button" value="name">Name</button></th><th scope="col"><button class="table-sort" type="button" value="sites">Sites</button></th><th scope="col" class="text-end"><button class="table-sort" type="button" value="paid" data-sort-first="descending">Paid</button></th></tr></thead>
	<tbody>
		<tr><td>Example Resort</td><td class="tabular-nums">3</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums" data-sort-value="48000">48,000</td></tr>
		<tr><td>Example Cruises</td><td class="tabular-nums">1</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums" data-sort-value="9600">9,600</td></tr>
		<tr><td>Example Divers</td><td class="tabular-nums">2</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums" data-sort-value="21300">21,300</td></tr>
		<tr><td>Example Hostel</td><td class="tabular-nums"></td><td class="text-end tabular-nums" data-sort-value="">-</td></tr>
	</tbody>
</table>
```

The table fires the cancelable `redz:sort` with `{key, direction}` first. A page that sorts itself - a list in pages from the server - cancels it, and may answer with a promise by `event.detail.respondWith`: the button is busy meanwhile, and a refusal puts the header's order back. The header says the new order either way.

Where the server sorts, the header holds a link instead - `a class="table-sort"` to the same list in the other order - drawn the same way.

```html
<table class="table" aria-label="Owners, sorted by the server">
	<thead><tr><th scope="col"><a class="table-sort" href="#table-sort-links">Name</a></th><th scope="col" class="text-end" aria-sort="descending"><a class="table-sort" href="#table-sort-links">Paid</a></th></tr></thead>
	<tbody>
		<tr><td>Example Resort</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">48,000</td></tr>
		<tr><td>Example Divers</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">21,300</td></tr>
	</tbody>
</table>
```

### Groups and subtotals

A row `table-group` heads the rows under it: one `th scope="rowgroup"` across the table, a band that does not stick, with an end slot `table-group-end` for its count or sum. In a table wider than its scroller the end slot stays at the scroller's visible end, over the band's label. A row `table-subtotal` closes a group in bold under a line. A [search field](list-group.md#list-group-search) over the table keeps a group's band and subtotal while a row of the group matches.

```html
<input class="form-control" type="search" name="q" data-filter="table-grouped" aria-label="Find a guest" placeholder="Find a guest" autocomplete="off">
<table class="table" aria-label="Bookings by boat">
	<thead><tr><th scope="col">Guest</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Seats</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Paid</th></tr></thead>
	<tbody>
		<tr class="table-group"><th scope="rowgroup" colspan="3">Boat A<span class="table-group-end">2 bookings</span></th></tr>
		<tr><td>Alex Sample</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">2</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">5,000</td></tr>
		<tr><td>Ben Sample</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">3</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">7,500</td></tr>
		<tr class="table-subtotal"><th scope="row">Boat A</th><td class="text-end tabular-nums">5</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">12,500</td></tr>
		<tr class="table-group"><th scope="rowgroup" colspan="3">Boat C<span class="table-group-end">1 booking</span></th></tr>
		<tr><td>Chris Sample</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">4</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">10,000</td></tr>
		<tr class="table-subtotal"><th scope="row">Boat C</th><td class="text-end tabular-nums">4</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">10,000</td></tr>
	</tbody>
</table>
```

The head of a table sticks under the app's header as the page scrolls; inside a region that scrolls on its own - a `dialog-body`, a `card-scroll` card's body - it sticks to the region's top.

### Wider than its card

A table with more columns than its card has room for goes in a `table-scroll`: it scrolls sideways inside the card, and `table-scroll-first` holds its first column in place, `table-scroll-last` its last, where a row's buttons stay in view. Where the browser lets an element scroll on one axis alone - Chrome 156 on - the head still sticks to the page as it scrolls down; elsewhere the head scrolls away with the page and the rest works the same. The wrapper is a named region. The library makes it a tab stop while its table is wider than it, so a keyboard can scroll it, and takes the stop away while the table fits.

```html
<section class="card" aria-labelledby="table-wide-title">
	<div class="card-header"><h2 class="fs-14" id="table-wide-title">Seats by day</h2></div>
	<div class="table-scroll table-scroll-first" role="region" aria-labelledby="table-wide-title">
		<table class="table">
			<thead><tr><th scope="col">Boat</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Mon</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Tue</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Wed</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Thu</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Fri</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Sat</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Sun</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Week</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Last week</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Change</th></tr></thead>
			<tbody>
				<tr class="table-group"><th scope="rowgroup" colspan="11">Island tours<span class="table-group-end">3 boats, 651 seats</span></th></tr>
				<tr><th scope="row">Boat A</th><td class="text-end tabular-nums">42</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">38</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">40</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">44</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">46</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">48</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">28</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">286</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">270</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums"><bdi>+16</bdi></td></tr>
				<tr><th scope="row">Boat C</th><td class="text-end tabular-nums">30</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">28</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">27</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">31</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">33</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">35</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">17</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">201</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">214</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums"><bdi>-13</bdi></td></tr>
				<tr><th scope="row">Boat B</th><td class="text-end tabular-nums">22</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">20</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">24</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">23</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">25</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">30</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">20</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">164</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">150</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums"><bdi>+14</bdi></td></tr>
			</tbody>
		</table>
	</div>
</section>
```

Put a band's label and its end slot in a `table-group-line` to keep them both in view while the table scrolls sideways: the line is as wide as the part of the table that shows. The label is one element, before the slot. When the two do not fit, the slot goes under the label at the start, and a slot wider than the line wraps inside itself. A band without a line keeps its label in the table and its slot at the visible end.

```html
<section class="card" aria-labelledby="table-band-line-title">
	<div class="card-header"><h2 class="fs-14" id="table-band-line-title">Trips by route</h2></div>
	<div class="table-scroll" role="region" aria-labelledby="table-band-line-title">
		<table class="table">
			<thead><tr><th scope="col">Boat</th><th scope="col">Skipper</th><th scope="col">Pier</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Seats</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Booked</th><th scope="col">Leaves</th></tr></thead>
			<tbody>
				<tr class="table-group"><th scope="rowgroup" colspan="6"><div class="table-group-line"><span><i class="bi bi-geo-alt me-4" aria-hidden="true"></i><a href="#table-band-line">Island tours</a></span><span class="table-group-end tabular-nums">Boats: 6 · booked: 412 of 651 seats · 1,204 km <span class="badge badge-subtle-danger">1 held</span> <span class="badge badge-subtle-warning">2 late</span></span></div></th></tr>
				<tr><td>Boat A</td><td>Example Skipper</td><td>North pier</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">42</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">38</td><td>08:00</td></tr>
				<tr class="table-group"><th scope="rowgroup" colspan="6"><div class="table-group-line"><span>Harbor cruises</span><span class="table-group-end">2 boats</span></div></th></tr>
				<tr><td>Boat C</td><td>Example Skipper</td><td>South pier</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">30</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">28</td><td>10:30</td></tr>
				<tr class="table-group"><th scope="rowgroup" colspan="6"><div class="table-group-line"><span>Evening and full moon cruises around the northern islands</span><span class="table-group-end">1 boat</span></div></th></tr>
				<tr><td>Boat D</td><td>Example Skipper</td><td>East pier</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">24</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">20</td><td>19:15</td></tr>
			</tbody>
		</table>
	</div>
</section>
```

```html
<section class="card" aria-labelledby="table-wide-last-title">
	<div class="card-header"><h2 class="fs-14" id="table-wide-last-title">Rates</h2></div>
	<div class="table-scroll table-scroll-last" role="region" aria-labelledby="table-wide-last-title">
		<table class="table">
			<thead><tr><th scope="col">Boat</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Low</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">High</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Peak</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Children</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Groups</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Agents</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Guides</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Fuel</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Park fee</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Insurance</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Status</th></tr></thead>
			<tbody>
				<tr><th scope="row">Boat A</th><td class="text-end tabular-nums">2,500</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">2,900</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">3,400</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">1,900</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">2,200</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">2,100</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">900</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">300</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">300</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">120</td><td class="text-end"><button class="btn btn-xs btn-primary" type="button">Save</button></td></tr>
				<tr><th scope="row">Boat C</th><td class="text-end tabular-nums">2,200</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">2,600</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">3,000</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">1,700</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">2,000</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">1,900</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">800</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">280</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">300</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">110</td><td class="text-end"><button class="btn btn-xs btn-primary" type="button">Save</button></td></tr>
			</tbody>
		</table>
	</div>
</section>
```

A product sets the look of every table head in its tokens: `--redz-table-head-bg`, `--redz-table-head-text`, `--redz-table-head-weight`, and `--redz-table-head-border`, the whole line under it.

### The current, the chosen and the running row

A row with `aria-current` - the record open beside the list - carries the accent's mark at its start; a row with `aria-selected="true"`, chosen in a grid of rows, is tinted; `table-active`, Bootstrap's name, marks the row that is running now.

```html
<table class="table" aria-label="Jobs">
	<tbody>
		<tr aria-current="true"><td>Rebuild the Thai pages</td><td class="text-muted">Open on the right</td></tr>
		<tr aria-selected="true"><td>Import the price list</td><td class="text-muted">Chosen</td></tr>
		<tr class="table-active"><td>Send the morning letters</td><td class="text-muted">Running now</td></tr>
		<tr><td>Clean the old photos</td><td class="text-muted">Waiting</td></tr>
	</tbody>
</table>
```

### A whole row as a link

The row's title link with Bootstrap's `stretched-link` makes the whole row a link: a click anywhere on it but on its own controls and their cells (`table-check`, `table-actions`) follows the title - with `Ctrl`, `Cmd` or the middle button into a new tab - unless the person was selecting its text. The title stays the one link a keyboard and a screen reader meet. The library does it by script, as Safari gives a positioned row no box for the link's cover.

```html
<table class="table" aria-label="Guides">
	<tbody>
		<tr><td><a class="table-title stretched-link" href="#table-links">Alex Sample</a><div class="table-sub">Thai, English</div></td><td class="tabular-nums">12 tours</td><td class="table-actions"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text" type="button" aria-label="Message: Alex Sample"><i class="bi bi-chat" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></td></tr>
		<tr><td><a class="table-title stretched-link" href="#table-links">Hana Sample</a><div class="table-sub">Japanese, English</div></td><td class="tabular-nums">7 tours</td><td class="table-actions"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text" type="button" aria-label="Message: Hana Sample"><i class="bi bi-chat" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></td></tr>
	</tbody>
</table>
```

## States

A row's tone marks what needs attention: `table-danger` failed, `table-warning` needs a look, `table-secondary` is out of use. On a pointer screen the row's actions show on hover and on focus; on a touch screen they always show.

## Keyboard and accessibility

- The row's title is a link; its actions are buttons named with the record - "Edit: North Bay", not a column of identical "Edit".
- The column of actions has a hidden header, and each check its own name: "Select: North Bay".
- A tone is never the only sign: a failed row also says why in its `table-note`, with an icon.
- Numbers sit at the end of their cells with `tabular-nums`, so their digits line up.
- A table being reloaded turns busy on its card's body: `REDZ.ui.busy(body, promise)` - not on the `<table>`, which cannot hold an overlay.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/table.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/table.css). It declares `--redz-table-head-border`, `--redz-table-head-weight`, `--redz-row-tint`, `--redz-row-mark` on its root, never on rows or items.

It reads the theme's `--redz-sticky-top`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-row-pad`, `--redz-border`, `--redz-table-head-bg`, `--redz-bg`, `--redz-table-head-text`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-fs-12`, `--redz-text`, `--redz-fs-14`, `--redz-bg-page`, `--redz-space-16`, `--redz-space-4`, `--redz-table-scroll-size`, `--redz-border-strong`, `--redz-row-hover`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-radius-12`, `--redz-font-mono`, `--redz-danger-subtle`, `--redz-danger`, `--redz-warning-subtle`, `--redz-warning`, `--redz-primary-subtle`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `caption-top` | - | missing |  |
| `table-dark` | - | review | row tones are danger, warning and secondary |
| `table-hover` | - | remove | every table lights its row under the pointer; table-static keeps one still |
| `table-info` | - | review | row tones are danger, warning and secondary |
| `table-light` | - | review | row tones are danger, warning and secondary |
| `table-primary` | - | review | row tones are danger, warning and secondary |
| `table-responsive` | `table-scroll` | rename | the wrapper scrolls sideways, table-scroll-first holds the first column; or columns hide below md: |
| `table-success` | - | review | row tones are danger, warning and secondary |

# Redrawn regions

A region the page draws again - a list it asks the server for every few seconds, a card after a change - keeps what the person was doing in it. `REDZ.ui.swap()` waits while a menu is open in the region, puts the new content in, and carries the filter, the sort, the search, the ticked rows, the open parts, the scroll and the focus over by id. A part that did not change stays as it is, its menu open.

## Examples

Type in the search, press Online, sort by Load, tick a row, open the maintenance window, scroll the table sideways, open a row's menu - then redraw. Each redraw changes one server's load: the other rows stay as they are, and a menu open in one of them stays open. A menu open in the changed row holds the redraw until it closes.

```html
<div class="hstack gap-12 flex-wrap align-items-center">
	<button class="btn btn-sm" type="button" data-docs-run="swap-now"><i class="bi bi-arrow-clockwise" aria-hidden="true"></i>Redraw</button>
	<label class="form-check"><input class="switch" type="checkbox" role="switch" id="swap-auto"> Redraw every 3 seconds</label>
</div>
<section class="card" id="swap-servers" aria-labelledby="swap-servers-title">
	<div class="card-header"><h3 id="swap-servers-title">Servers</h3><span class="text-muted fs-12" id="swap-drawn">Drawn by the server</span></div>
	<div class="card-body vstack gap-12">
		<div class="hstack gap-8 flex-wrap">
			<input class="form-control form-control-sm" type="search" id="swap-find" data-filter="swap-table" placeholder="Find a server" aria-label="Find a server" autocomplete="off">
			<div class="btn-group" role="group" aria-label="State">
				<button class="btn btn-sm" type="button" command="--filter" aria-controls="swap-table" value="" aria-pressed="true">All</button>
				<button class="btn btn-sm" type="button" command="--filter" aria-controls="swap-table" value="online" aria-pressed="false">Online</button>
				<button class="btn btn-sm" type="button" command="--filter" aria-controls="swap-table" value="offline" aria-pressed="false">Offline</button>
			</div>
		</div>
		<details id="swap-window"><summary>Maintenance window</summary><p class="text-muted m-0">Sundays from 02:00 to 04:00, one server at a time.</p></details>
		<div class="table-scroll" role="region" aria-labelledby="swap-servers-title">
			<table class="table" id="swap-table" data-select>
				<thead><tr><th scope="col"><input class="check" type="checkbox" id="swap-all" data-select-all aria-label="All servers"></th><th scope="col" aria-sort="ascending"><button class="table-sort" type="button" value="name">Name</button></th><th scope="col" class="text-end"><button class="table-sort" type="button" value="load" data-sort-first="descending">Load</button></th><th scope="col">State</th><th scope="col"><span class="visually-hidden">Actions</span></th></tr></thead>
				<tbody>
					<tr id="swap-web-01" data-state="online" data-sort-load="12"><td><input class="check" type="checkbox" name="servers[]" value="web-01" aria-label="web-01"></td><td>web-01</td><td class="text-end">12%</td><td>Online</td><td class="text-end"><button class="btn btn-icon btn-sm" type="button" commandfor="swap-menu-web-01" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="Actions for web-01"><i class="bi bi-three-dots" aria-hidden="true"></i></button><div class="menu" id="swap-menu-web-01" popover role="menu" aria-label="web-01"><button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem">Restart</button><button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem">Open logs</button></div></td></tr>
					<tr id="swap-web-02" data-state="online" data-sort-load="47"><td><input class="check" type="checkbox" name="servers[]" value="web-02" aria-label="web-02"></td><td>web-02</td><td class="text-end">47%</td><td>Online</td><td class="text-end"><button class="btn btn-icon btn-sm" type="button" commandfor="swap-menu-web-02" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="Actions for web-02"><i class="bi bi-three-dots" aria-hidden="true"></i></button><div class="menu" id="swap-menu-web-02" popover role="menu" aria-label="web-02"><button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem">Restart</button><button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem">Open logs</button></div></td></tr>
					<tr id="swap-db-01" data-state="online" data-sort-load="63"><td><input class="check" type="checkbox" name="servers[]" value="db-01" aria-label="db-01"></td><td>db-01</td><td class="text-end">63%</td><td>Online</td><td class="text-end"><button class="btn btn-icon btn-sm" type="button" commandfor="swap-menu-db-01" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="Actions for db-01"><i class="bi bi-three-dots" aria-hidden="true"></i></button><div class="menu" id="swap-menu-db-01" popover role="menu" aria-label="db-01"><button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem">Restart</button><button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem">Open logs</button></div></td></tr>
					<tr id="swap-mail-01" data-state="offline" data-sort-load="0"><td><input class="check" type="checkbox" name="servers[]" value="mail-01" aria-label="mail-01"></td><td>mail-01</td><td class="text-end">0%</td><td>Offline</td><td class="text-end"><button class="btn btn-icon btn-sm" type="button" commandfor="swap-menu-mail-01" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="Actions for mail-01"><i class="bi bi-three-dots" aria-hidden="true"></i></button><div class="menu" id="swap-menu-mail-01" popover role="menu" aria-label="mail-01"><button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem">Restart</button><button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem">Open logs</button></div></td></tr>
					<tr id="swap-files-01" data-state="online" data-sort-load="28"><td><input class="check" type="checkbox" name="servers[]" value="files-01" aria-label="files-01"></td><td>files-01</td><td class="text-end">28%</td><td>Online</td><td class="text-end"><button class="btn btn-icon btn-sm" type="button" commandfor="swap-menu-files-01" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="Actions for files-01"><i class="bi bi-three-dots" aria-hidden="true"></i></button><div class="menu" id="swap-menu-files-01" popover role="menu" aria-label="files-01"><button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem">Restart</button><button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem">Open logs</button></div></td></tr>
				</tbody>
			</table>
		</div>
	</div>
</section>
```

The page asks its server, makes nodes of the answer and hands them over; the library makes no request and parses no string. A `<template>`, a `DOMParser` document or a request with `responseType = 'document'` make the nodes - under Trusted Types that parse is the page's own, through its policy, or the page hands over the policy's `TrustedHTML` as it is.

```js
const answer = await (await fetch('/servers/list')).text();
const template = document.createElement('template');
template.innerHTML = answer; // or policy.createHTML(answer) under Trusted Types
await REDZ.ui.swap(document.getElementById('swap-servers'), template.content);
```

## What is carried over

The new content is the server's; what the person set in the old content is set again in the new one, matched by id. Give the parts ids: rows, tables, scroll boxes, toggled regions, the buttons that open menus by `commandfor`.

| What | Matched by |
| --- | --- |
| A filter's pressed buttons (`command="--filter"`) | The region the buttons name |
| A search's words (`data-filter`) and the words of the focused field | The field's id; a field of a [tracked form](save-bar.md) is never written |
| A table's sort (`aria-sort`) | The table's id, the column's sort value or place |
| The ticked checks of a selection (`data-select`) | The selection's id, each check's value |
| The selected tab (`aria-selected`) | The tab list's id and the tab's |
| An open `details`, a `--toggle` region, a tree group | Its id |
| The scroll of the region and of its scroll boxes | The box's id, else its place among the region's `.table-scroll` |
| The window's scroll, when the region starts above the window | The first element with an id in view, held where it was |
| The focus and a field's caret | The id; else the button with the same `commandfor`, or the same `aria-controls` and `command`; else a field with the same name and value; else the first control of the nearest part with an id; else the region itself |

Not carried: pages a "show more" list loaded, which are data - ask the server for as many - and anything the page set by its own script, which `redz:swap` lets it set again.

## When it waits

A swap goes in at once when nothing in the region is in use. It waits while what it would take out holds a menu, a popover or a dialog that is open - or one opened from a button in it - a [tracked form](save-bar.md) with changes, or words being composed with an input method, and tries again as each of those ends: no timer. A newer swap of the same region overtakes a waiting one, which answers `false`; so does an aborted `signal`. Typing in a field does not hold a swap: its words, caret and focus are carried.

Elements with an id are parts. A part whose new copy is equal to the copy the last swap brought - the first time, to the part as it stands - stays as it is: its menu open, its spinner turning, its focus. Where the browser moves a node alive (`moveBefore`: Chrome 133, Firefox 144) such a part never holds a swap; elsewhere, Safari among them, it is moved as any node is and holds the swap like the rest.

## From code

| Call or event | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `REDZ.ui.swap(region, source, {signal})` | Puts the source's content into the region; a promise of `true` once it is in, `false` when a newer swap overtook it or the signal aborted. `source` is a `DocumentFragment`, a `Document`, an `Element` or a `TrustedHTML`; when it holds an element with the region's id, that element's children are taken, else all of it. Its scripts are dropped, its nodes taken. |
| `REDZ.ui.swap(source, {signal})` | Puts each top element of the source that has an id into its namesake on the page - a card's head and its regions from one answer. A promise of `true` when every one went in. |
| `redz:swap` | Fired on the region, bubbling, once the new content is in and carried over: the moment for the page's own setup of it. |

## Keyboard and accessibility

- The focus stays where the person was: on the same control, or on its nearest namesake. When the row it was on is gone, the region takes it - made focusable with `tabindex="-1"` - so the next Tab goes on from there, not from the top of the page.
- A swap says nothing aloud. A list that changes under a person's eyes - new rows, a state that turned - is for the page to say, in its own words, with a [status line](status.md) or a toast.
- Redraw no faster than people read: every few seconds at most, and not while nothing changed.

# Logs and diffs

What a job printed, line by line as it runs, and what changed between two versions of a text - a template, a setting, a translation.

## A log

`pre class="log"` sets a job's output in the monospace font, wraps its long lines and scrolls in its own box once a `max-h-*` utility caps its height - give it `tabindex="0"` then, so the keyboard scrolls it too. A line in a `span` with `data-tone` - `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `info` or `muted` - takes that tone; the words still say what happened. With `data-follow` the end stays in view while lines come in, as in a terminal, unless the reader scrolled up to read an earlier one; back at the end, it follows again.

```html
		<pre class="log max-h-160" id="log-follow-lines" role="region" tabindex="0" data-follow aria-label="The import's output" dir="ltr"><span data-tone="muted">09:14:02</span> Import started: excursions.csv, 128 rows
<span data-tone="muted">09:14:02</span> Columns: title, price, date, seats, language
<span data-tone="muted">09:14:02</span> Row 1-20 read
<span data-tone="muted">09:14:02</span> Row 21-40 read
<span data-tone="warning"><span data-tone="muted">09:14:03</span> Row 41: no price, set to 0</span>
<span data-tone="muted">09:14:03</span> Row 42-60 read
<span data-tone="muted">09:14:03</span> Row 61-90 read
<span data-tone="danger"><span data-tone="muted">09:14:04</span> Row 91: the date 2026-02-30 does not exist, skipped</span>
<span data-tone="muted">09:14:04</span> Row 92-128 read
<span data-tone="success"><span data-tone="muted">09:14:05</span> 127 excursions imported, 1 skipped</span></pre>
		<div class="hstack gap-8"><button class="btn btn-secondary" type="button" data-docs-run="log-line" aria-controls="log-follow-lines">Add a line</button></div>
```

### Any box that follows

`data-follow` works on any element that scrolls - a thread of messages, a list of events: it keeps its end in view while its contents come in or grow, a picture that loads included. A button with `command="--follow"` and `aria-controls` naming the box shows while the reader is away from the end and something new came in; pressed, it brings the end back, follows again and hides. In a `follow-dock` - the box's last child - it floats at the middle of the box's bottom edge. With `data-follow="current"` the box keeps its child with `aria-current` in view instead - a running job's step - at the nearest edge, with the room of one step beside it, and its end while it has none; only the box scrolls, never the page, and once the reader scrolls the step out of view it waits until it is back.

```html
<div class="card card-scroll max-h-240">
	<div class="card-header"><h2 class="fs-14" id="log-thread-title">Request 24-0187</h2></div>
	<div class="card-body vstack gap-8" id="log-thread-box" role="region" tabindex="0" aria-labelledby="log-thread-title" data-follow>
		<p>A Sample: The pier gate does not open at 07:00.</p>
		<p>B Sample: The guard has the key from 06:45; I asked him to wait.</p>
		<p>A Sample: Thank you. Is the boat still at 07:30?</p>
		<p>B Sample: Yes, it leaves at 07:30 from the second pier.</p>
		<div class="follow-dock"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary rounded-full" type="button" command="--follow" aria-controls="log-thread-box" hidden><i class="bi bi-arrow-down" aria-hidden="true"></i>New messages</button></div>
	</div>
</div>
<div class="hstack gap-8"><button class="btn btn-secondary" type="button" data-docs-run="log-message" aria-controls="log-thread-box">Add a message</button></div>
```

```html
<ol class="step-list max-h-160 overflow-auto max-w-320" id="log-steps-list" tabindex="0" aria-label="Updating the site" data-follow="current">
	<li data-state="done"><i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i>Download</li>
	<li data-state="done"><i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i>Compare every file</li>
	<li data-state="current" aria-current="step"><i class="bi bi-arrow-repeat" aria-hidden="true"></i>Apply the changes</li>
	<li data-state="pending"><i class="bi bi-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i>Check the schema</li>
	<li data-state="pending"><i class="bi bi-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i>Clear the caches</li>
	<li data-state="pending"><i class="bi bi-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i>Switch to the new version</li>
</ol>
<div class="hstack gap-8"><button class="btn btn-secondary" type="button" data-docs-run="log-step" aria-controls="log-steps-list">Next step</button></div>
```

## A diff

`div class="diff"` holds one element a line: an `ins` is a line added, marked "+" and tinted green, a `del` a line taken away, "-" and red, anything else a line kept. In a kept line, `del` and `ins` show the words changed inside it, side by side. It scrolls in its own box past 25rem, a `max-h-*` utility sets another height, and it prints in full; one that may scroll takes `tabindex="0"` and a name, so a keyboard reaches it. Lines of code carry `translate="no"`, so a page's translator leaves them as they are, and a log or a diff of code is `dir="ltr"` on a right-to-left page; a diff of Arabic words keeps the page's direction.

```html
<div class="diff" role="group" aria-label="The changes of the page's title" dir="ltr">
	<span translate="no">&lt;header class="vstack gap-8"&gt;</span>
	<del translate="no">	&lt;h1&gt;North Bay by speedboat&lt;/h1&gt;</del>
	<ins translate="no">	&lt;h1&gt;North Bay marine park by speedboat&lt;/h1&gt;</ins>
	<span translate="no">	&lt;p&gt;A day among <del>forty</del><ins>forty-two</ins> islands.&lt;/p&gt;</span>
	<span translate="no">&lt;/header&gt;</span>
</div>
```

## Accessibility

- A log that scrolls is focusable and named, so a keyboard reaches it and a screen reader says what it is. A log the person waits on may be `role="log"`, a live region that says new lines politely; one that prints many lines a second says a summary instead.
- A diff says its changes in its signs and its words, not in its colors: a screen reader reads "+" and "-" before a line, and in forced colors an added word is underlined and a removed one struck through.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/log.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/log.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-border`, `--redz-radius-8`, `--redz-text`, `--redz-font-mono`, `--redz-fs-12`, `--redz-lh-20`, `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-bg-page`, `--redz-success-text`, `--redz-warning-text`, `--redz-danger-text`, `--redz-info-text`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-bg`, `--redz-success-subtle`, `--redz-danger-subtle`, `--redz-success`, `--redz-danger`.

# Commands to copy

A command a person runs on their own machine - an install line, a crontab entry, a request with a key - shown on one line, copied whole by one button.

## Examples

`command-line` is one frame: a `pre tabindex="0" translate="no"` holding a `code`, and a `--copy` button in its own column. The command stays on one line, left to right on any page, and scrolls sideways under a fade at the cut edge - never under the button; a click selects it whole. The button without `aria-controls` copies its command. The words above name it: the box is `role="group"` with `aria-labelledby`, as a `pre` may carry no name of its own.

```html
<p id="command-line-cron-title">Add this line to the server's crontab:</p>
<div class="command-line" role="group" aria-labelledby="command-line-cron-title">
	<pre tabindex="0" translate="no"><code>*/5 * * * * php /var/www/example/cron.php --task=maintenance --quiet &gt;&gt; /var/log/example-cron.log 2&gt;&amp;1</code></pre>
	<button class="btn btn-icon" type="button" command="--copy" aria-label="Copy the command"><i class="bi bi-copy" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
</div>
```

A `var` in the command is a part the person puts in themselves - a key, a host - and shows as an amber chip. A page that fills it later, on a reveal, writes plain text in its place.

```html
<p id="command-line-key-title">Ask for the bookings of today:</p>
<div class="command-line" role="group" aria-labelledby="command-line-key-title">
	<pre tabindex="0" translate="no"><code>curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <var>YOUR_KEY</var>" https://api.example.com/v1/bookings?day=today</code></pre>
	<button class="btn btn-icon" type="button" command="--copy" aria-label="Copy the command"><i class="bi bi-copy" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
</div>
```

### Steps

`ol class="command-steps"` numbers commands run one after another, each step a line of words and its `command-line`, in circles joined by a line. A `--copy` button whose `aria-controls` names the list copies all its commands, a line each. Commands that are alternatives - one or the other - go in a plain `vstack` instead.

```html
<div class="hstack gap-8"><h4 class="fs-14 flex-grow-1" id="command-line-install-title">Install the agent</h4><button class="btn btn-sm" type="button" command="--copy" aria-controls="command-line-install-list"><i class="bi bi-copy" aria-hidden="true"></i>Copy all</button></div>
<ol class="command-steps" id="command-line-install-list" aria-labelledby="command-line-install-title">
	<li><p id="command-line-install-1">Download it:</p><div class="command-line" role="group" aria-labelledby="command-line-install-1"><pre tabindex="0" translate="no"><code>curl -fsSLO https://get.example.com/agent/agent-2.4.tar.gz</code></pre><button class="btn btn-icon" type="button" command="--copy" aria-label="Copy the command"><i class="bi bi-copy" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></div></li>
	<li><p id="command-line-install-2">Unpack it:</p><div class="command-line" role="group" aria-labelledby="command-line-install-2"><pre tabindex="0" translate="no"><code>tar -xzf agent-2.4.tar.gz -C /opt</code></pre><button class="btn btn-icon" type="button" command="--copy" aria-label="Copy the command"><i class="bi bi-copy" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></div></li>
	<li><p id="command-line-install-3">Start it:</p><div class="command-line" role="group" aria-labelledby="command-line-install-3"><pre tabindex="0" translate="no"><code>/opt/agent/start --key <var>YOUR_KEY</var></code></pre><button class="btn btn-icon" type="button" command="--copy" aria-label="Copy the command"><i class="bi bi-copy" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></div></li>
</ol>
```

## Accessibility

- The command is a tab stop, so a keyboard scrolls it; its words above it name the group.
- The copy button says what it copies in its name and says politely that it did, in the page's texts `copy.done` and `copy.failed`.
- `translate="no"` keeps a page's translator from turning the command into words.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/command-line.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/command-line.css). It declares `--redz-btn-bg`, `--redz-btn-fg`, `--redz-btn-hover`, `--redz-btn-hover-fg`, `--redz-command-fade-start`, `--redz-command-fade-end` on its root, never on rows or items.

It reads the theme's `--redz-border`, `--redz-radius-8`, `--redz-bg-page`, `--redz-focus`, `--redz-control-height`, `--redz-lh-20`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-text`, `--redz-font-mono`, `--redz-fs-12`, `--redz-radius-4`, `--redz-warning-subtle`, `--redz-warning-text`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-bg-hover`, `--redz-space-16`, `--redz-space-4`, `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-border-strong`, `--redz-bg`.

# Summaries and totals

The facts of one record in pairs - a label and its value - and the sums at the foot of an invoice or a booking.

## Examples

`summary` on a `<dl>`: the terms in a column as wide as the longest, the values beside them; in a region narrower than 30rem each value goes under its term.

```html
<section class="card" aria-labelledby="summary-booking-title">
	<div class="card-header"><h2 class="fs-14" id="summary-booking-title">Booking 24-0187</h2></div>
	<div class="card-body">
		<dl class="summary">
			<dt>Excursion</dt><dd>North Bay: marine park by speedboat</dd>
			<dt>Date</dt><dd>14 December 2026, 08:30</dd>
			<dt>Guests</dt><dd>2 adults, 1 child</dd>
			<dt>Pickup</dt><dd>East beach, the hotel's lobby</dd>
		</dl>
	</div>
</section>
```

### Totals

`totals` on a `<dl>` of rows - a `<div>` each, its label and its value - the numbers at the end in `tabular-nums`; `totals-grand` on the last row draws it larger, under a line.

```html
<dl class="totals">
	<div><dt>2 adults × 2,500 THB</dt><dd>5,000 THB</dd></div>
	<div><dt>1 child × 1,500 THB</dt><dd>1,500 THB</dd></div>
	<div><dt>Discount, early booking</dt><dd>-650 THB</dd></div>
	<div class="totals-grand"><dt>To pay</dt><dd>5,850 THB</dd></div>
</dl>
```

### In a confirmation

`REDZ.ui.confirm({rows: [{label, value}]})` shows the same pairs in its dialog - what a payment is, what a move changes - after its note and before its lists; every word is text, never HTML.

```html
<button class="btn btn-primary" type="button" data-docs-run="confirm-rows">Pay 5,850 THB</button>
```

## Accessibility

- A description list tells a screen reader which value belongs to which term, so no heading is needed for each pair.
- A sum written with its sign - "-650 THB" - says a discount without color.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/summary.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/summary.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-space-16`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-text`, `--redz-space-4`, `--redz-border`, `--redz-fs-16`.

# Badges

A badge is a short label of state or count beside the thing it describes: Published, Draft, 5 new. It never acts - a badge that does something is a chip or a button.

## Examples

The plain `badge` is neutral, for a status that needs no attention. `badge-subtle-{tone}` is the usual colored form; `badge-{tone}`, filled, is for the one that must be seen. An icon before the words carries the meaning in forced colors and for people who do not tell the colors apart.

```html
<span class="badge"><i class="bi bi-check2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Published</span>
<span class="badge"><i class="bi bi-pencil-square" aria-hidden="true"></i>Draft</span>
<span class="badge badge-subtle-success"><i class="bi bi-check-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i>Paid</span>
<span class="badge badge-subtle-warning"><i class="bi bi-clock-history" aria-hidden="true"></i>Stale</span>
<span class="badge badge-subtle-danger"><i class="bi bi-x-octagon" aria-hidden="true"></i>Failed</span>
<span class="badge badge-subtle-info"><i class="bi bi-robot" aria-hidden="true"></i>Machine translation</span>
<span class="badge badge-subtle-primary">New</span>
<span class="badge badge-subtle-secondary">Archived</span>
```

### Filled

```html
<span class="badge badge-primary">5</span>
<span class="badge badge-secondary">Beta</span>
<span class="badge badge-success">Live</span>
<span class="badge badge-danger">Overdue</span>
<span class="badge badge-warning">Due today</span>
<span class="badge badge-info">Update</span>
```

`badge-inverse` is the text color with the page color on it - dark in the light theme, light in the dark one - for a mark that must stand apart from every tone: a whole company wiped beside rows deleted for good and rows moved to the bin.

```html
<span class="badge badge-danger">Deleted</span>
<span class="badge badge-warning">In the bin</span>
<span class="badge badge-inverse">Company wiped</span>
```

### Sizes

`badge-sm` for a mark inside a dense row, `badge-lg` for one that stands on its own.

```html
<span class="badge badge-subtle-primary badge-sm">Small</span>
<span class="badge badge-subtle-primary">Regular</span>
<span class="badge badge-subtle-primary badge-lg">Large</span>
```

### Beside other things

A count in a navigation link, a status in a heading.

```html
<nav class="nav nav-pills" aria-label="Orders">
	<a class="nav-link" href="#badge-beside" aria-current="page">New<span class="badge badge-subtle-primary">5</span></a>
```
